title: Sequential framework for predicting postoperative recurrence and antiseizure-medication withdrawal risk in mesial temporal lobe epilepsy
zh_title: 内侧颞叶癫痫术后复发与停用抗癫痫药风险的序贯预测框架
summary: 针对内侧颞叶癫痫，构建从术后复发预测到停药风险分层的序贯模型，在1278例多队列中验证，含外部验证集。
key_points: 1278例，4个队列，含1个前瞻性队列
术前52项多模态特征建模复发
reason: 多队列含前瞻性与外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Mesial temporal lobe epilepsy (mTLE) is a common drug-resistant epilepsy. Temporal lobe resection is the most effective treatment, but postoperative recurrence and antiseizure medication (ASM) withdrawal remain major clinical challenges. Existing prediction tools are limited by endpoint specificity, restricted external validation, and lack of integration into sequential postoperative management pathways. We developed a sequential modelling strategy in mTLE, spanning recurrence prediction to ASM withdrawal risk stratification. In phase 1, postoperative recurrence models were developed and validated using 52 preoperative multimodal features in 1278 patients across cohorts 1–4 (three retrospective, one prospective). Five top-ranked models achieved AUCs of 0.926–0.932 (internal) and 0.830–0.931 (three external sets), with a three-tier (low/intermediate/high) risk stratification. In phase 2, ASM withdrawal recurrence models were developed and validated in 679 seizure-free, phase 1 low/intermediate-risk patients eligible for withdrawal across cohorts 5–8 (three retrospective, one prospective). Five top-ranked models achieved AUCs of 0.897–0.902 (internal) and 0.789–0.933 (three external sets), with risk stratification for individualized withdrawal estimation. Models showed good calibration, net clinical benefit, and SHAP-based interpretability. A research-based risk-estimation web tool was developed to support potential clinical translation. This promising modelling strategy integrates population-level risk stratification with individualized prediction, providing preliminary postoperative guidance: high-recurrence-risk patients may not be ideal for early ASM withdrawal despite seizure freedom, while low-risk patients may be considered for earlier withdrawal evaluation. Given the primarily retrospective design and relatively small phase 2 prospective cohort, further prospective external validation and clinical-impact studies are required before routine implementation.
zh_abstract: 内侧颞叶癫痫（mTLE）是一种常见的药物难治性癫痫。颞叶切除术是最有效的治疗方法，但术后复发和抗癫痫药物（ASM）停药仍是主要的临床挑战。现有预测工具受限于终点特异性、外部验证有限，以及缺乏与术后序贯管理路径的整合。我们在mTLE中建立了一种序贯建模策略，涵盖从复发预测到ASM停药风险分层。在第1阶段，利用队列1–4（三个回顾性队列，一个前瞻性队列）共1278例患者的52项术前多模态特征，开发并验证了术后复发模型。排名前五的模型内部验证AUC为0.926–0.932，三个外部数据集AUC为0.830–0.931，并实现了三级（低/中/高）风险分层。在第2阶段，在队列5–8（三个回顾性队列，一个前瞻性队列）中，对679例无发作且第1阶段为低/中风险、符合停药条件的患者开发并验证了ASM停药后复发模型。排名前五的模型内部验证AUC为0.897–0.902，三个外部数据集AUC为0.789–0.933，并可进行风险分层以估计个体化停药情况。模型显示出良好的校准度、净临床获益以及基于SHAP的可解释性。我们还开发了一个基于研究的风险评估网络工具，以支持潜在的临床转化。这一有前景的建模策略将人群水平的风险分层与个体化预测相结合，提供了初步的术后指导：复发风险高的患者尽管已无发作，可能不适合早期停用ASM，而低风险患者可考虑较早进行停药评估。鉴于研究主要为回顾性设计，且第2阶段前瞻性队列相对较小，在常规实施之前仍需进一步的前瞻性外部验证和临床影响研究。

title: Multimodal AI for bacterial vs viral upper respiratory tract infection multicentre development and internal validation
zh_title: 咽部图像与临床元数据多模态AI鉴别细菌性与病毒性上呼吸道感染
summary: 融合咽部图像与临床元数据的模型，在44家机构6666次就诊数据上区分A组链球菌与非GAS，内部验证AUC 0.917。
key_points: Swin Transformer融合元数据，使用119,988张图像
AUC 0.917，高于仅图像0.902和仅元数据0.871
模拟显示抗生素处方可减少23–56%
reason: 多中心大样本但仅内部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Distinguishing Group A streptococcus (GAS) pharyngitis from viral upper respiratory tract infections (URTIs) is critical for appropriate antibiotic use but remains difficult on symptoms alone. We developed and internally validated a multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) model fusing pharyngeal images (Swin Transformer) with clinical metadata via gradient boosting decision trees, using 6666 visits and 119,988 images from 44 facilities collected March 2023–August 2025. For discriminating GAS from non-GAS (influenza A/B, COVID-19), the fusion model achieved area under the curve (AUC) 0.917 (95% confidence interval 0.907–0.926), outperforming image-only (0.902), metadata-only (0.871) and proxy Centor/McIsaac scores. At a pre-specified high-specificity threshold (≥0.90) sensitivity was 0.761; simulations indicated antibiotic-prescription reductions of 23–56% across GAS prevalences of 5–20%. External validation and prospective evaluation are needed.
zh_abstract: 区分A组链球菌（GAS）咽炎与病毒性上呼吸道感染（URTI）对于合理使用抗生素至关重要，但仅凭症状仍难以区分。我们开发并进行了内部验证一种多模态人工智能（AI）模型，该模型通过梯度提升决策树将咽部图像（Swin Transformer）与临床元数据融合，使用了2023年3月至2025年8月期间来自44家机构的6666次就诊和119,988张图像。在区分GAS与非GAS（甲/乙型流感、COVID-19）方面，融合模型的曲线下面积（AUC）为0.917（95%置信区间0.907–0.926），优于仅图像模型（0.902）、仅元数据模型（0.871）以及替代的Centor/McIsaac评分。在预先设定的高特异度阈值（≥0.90）下，敏感度为0.761；模拟结果显示，在GAS患病率为5–20%的情况下，抗生素处方量可减少23–56%。仍需进行外部验证和前瞻性评估。

title: Performance of a mammography-based deep learning risk model across breast cancer tumor phenotypes.
zh_title: 基于乳腺钼靶的深度学习风险模型在不同肿瘤表型中的表现
summary: 多中心回顾性研究，评估纯影像深度学习模型Mirai在不同组织学亚型、分级、分子分型和分期乳腺癌中的区分能力。

abstract: [European radiology] Breast cancers have diverse biologic features associated with variable prognoses, treatment selection, and eligibility for targeted therapies. We evaluated the discriminatory performance of an image-only deep learning (DL) breast cancer risk model across diverse tumor phenotypes, including histologic subtypes, grades, molecular profiles, and disease stages. This retrospective, multisite study included consecutive women 30 years or older undergoing screening mammography across six sites from 2009 to 2022. A previously validated image-only DL model (Mirai) was used to generate risk scores from screening mammograms. Demographic data were retrieved from electronic health records, and cancers diagnosed within 1 year were identified through linkage to regional and state tumor registries. Discrimination across histologic subtypes, grades, molecular profiles, and stage was evaluated using areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs), with DeLong comparisons. Among 341,921 examinations in 104,472 patients (median age, 59 years [IQR, 51-68]), 1991 cancers were diagnosed, including 1543 (77.5%) invasive cancers and 448 (22.5%) ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS). Discrimination was similar for invasive cancer (AUC 0.81; 95% CI: 0.80-0.82) and DCIS (AUC 0.81; 95% CI: 0.79-0.83; p = 0.88) and did not differ between invasive ductal and lobular carcinomas (AUC 0.81 vs 0.78; p = 0.08). Discrimination was robust across grades for both invasive cancer and DCIS (AUC range, 0.79-0.83), molecular profiles (AUC range, 0.77-0.88), and stages (AUC range, 0.71-0.82). Screening mammograms contain imaging biomarkers associated with diverse breast cancer phenotypes. An image-only DL risk model demonstrated robust discrimination across histologic subtypes, grades, molecular profiles, and disease stages. zh_abstract: [European radiology] 乳腺癌具有多样的生物学特征，与不同的预后、治疗选择和靶向治疗资格相关。我们评估了仅基于图像的深度学习（DL）乳腺癌风险模型在不同肿瘤表型（包括组织学亚型、分级、分子特征和疾病分期）中的区分性能。这项回顾性多中心研究纳入了 2009 年至 2022 年间在六个中心接受筛查乳腺 X 线摄影的 30 岁及以上连续女性。使用先前已验证的仅基于图像的 DL 模型（Mirai）从筛查乳腺 X 线片生成风险评分。人口统计学数据取自电子健康记录，通过与区域和州肿瘤登记处关联确定 1 年内诊断的癌症。采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）及 DeLong 比较评估不同组织学亚型、分级、分子特征和分期的区分能力。在 104,472 例患者的 341,921 次检查中（中位年龄 59 岁［IQR，51-68］），共诊断出 1991 例癌症，其中 1543 例（77.5%）为浸润性癌，448 例（22.5%）为导管原位癌（DCIS）。浸润性癌（AUC 0.81；95% CI：0.80-0.82）与 DCIS（AUC 0.81；95% CI：0.79-0.83；p = 0.88）的区分能力相近，浸润性导管癌与小叶癌之间无差异（AUC 0.81 vs 0.78；p = 0.08）。无论是浸润性癌还是 DCIS，不同分级（AUC 范围 0.79-0.83）、分子特征（AUC 范围 0.77-0.88）和分期（AUC 范围 0.71-0.82）的区分能力均稳健。筛查乳腺 X 线片含有与多种乳腺癌表型相关的影像生物标志物。仅基于图像的 DL 风险模型在不同组织学亚型、分级、分子特征和疾病分期中表现出稳健的区分能力。问题：仅基于乳腺 X 线图像的深度学习乳腺癌风险模型（Mirai）在不同表型的乳腺癌中是否表现相近？发现：在包含 341,921 次筛查乳腺 X 线检查的多中心队列中，Mirai 在浸润性癌与导管原位癌之间表现出相似的区分能力，并在不同组织学亚型、肿瘤分级、分子特征和诊断时分期中保持稳健性能（AUC 范围 0.71-0.88）。临床意义：应用于筛查乳腺 X 线摄影的深度学习乳腺癌风险模型在多种表型的癌症中表现出稳健的区分性能，支持风险分层

title: Single-sequence, structure-free allosteric residue prediction with protein language models.
zh_title: 蛋白语言模型注意力图实现单序列无结构变构残基预测
summary: 蛋白语言模型的注意力图含变构信息，仅需单序列和活性位点即可预测变构关系，在109个变构蛋白基准上优于结构与共进化方法。
key_points: 无需任务特定训练或结构信息
在109个变构蛋白基准上优于对照方法
β2肾上腺素受体与丙氨酸扫描实验相关性更强
reason: 同行评审，基准对比充分并有实验关联，属值得一看档
abstract: [Cell systems] Large language models trained on protein sequences learn general coevolutionary relationships at scale, which contain useful structural and functional information. We show that attention maps, matrices of learned pairwise relationships between residues, include information about allostery. This enables prediction of allosteric relationships with no task-specific training, requiring a single input sequence and specified active-site residues, without structural information. Attention maps outperform established structure-based and sequence coevolution-based models across a benchmark of 109 allosteric proteins. In the beta-2 adrenergic receptor, a G-protein coupled receptor, attention maps correlate more strongly with experimental alanine-scanning measurements of allosteric effects on signaling than these comparators. Language model attention also guides efficient, low-throughput experimental discovery of putative allosteric residues in the protease DPP4 and residues coupled to the known allosteric pathway in ACE2. These results enable and demonstrate allosteric relationship prediction in a zero-shot, single-sequence, structure-free manner. We provide this method in the AlloGator web interface.
zh_abstract: [Cell systems] 在蛋白质序列上训练的大语言模型可大规模学习一般性的协同进化关系，这些关系包含有用的结构和功能信息。我们表明，注意力图（即残基之间习得的成对关系矩阵）包含有关变构（allostery）的信息。这使得无需任务特异性训练即可预测变构关系，仅需一条输入序列和指定的活性位点残基，无需结构信息。在包含109个变构蛋白的基准测试中，注意力图的表现优于已有的基于结构和基于序列协同进化的模型。在G蛋白偶联受体β2肾上腺素受体中，与这些对比方法相比，注意力图与变构效应对信号传导影响的实验丙氨酸扫描测量结果相关性更强。语言模型注意力还可指导在蛋白酶DPP4中高效、低通量地通过实验发现推定的变构残基，以及在ACE2中发现与已知变构通路相耦合的残基。这些结果实现并证明了以零样本、单序列、无需结构的方式预测变构关系。我们通过AlloGator网页界面提供该方法。

title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
zh_title: 基于基因信息的病理基础模型BioScore基准
summary: 提出BioScore基准，用空间转录组与稀疏自编码器评估病理基础模型对52种细胞身份的表征能力，并评分8个病理模型。
key_points: 以空间转录组为参照衡量细胞身份表征
稀疏自编码器无监督分解patch嵌入并聚类
评测8个病理基础模型与3个自然图像模型
reason: 病理基础模型新基准，生物学角度评测，有较充分对比，属预印本重要档
abstract: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.
zh_abstract: 病理基础模型通常依据其在分类和检索等下游任务上的表现来比较。此类基准衡量了模型的有用程度，却无法揭示其所表征的生物学内容。我们提出 BioScore，这是一个以同一组织的空间转录组学为参照，量化图像编码器捕获细胞身份能力的基准。稀疏自编码器将编码器的图像块嵌入分解为稀疏特征，我们再将其聚类为固定数量的组。随后，BioScore 针对由标记基因定义的 52 种细胞身份，衡量某一组特征在组织上跟随该身份表达的特异程度。由于自编码器训练完全无监督，匹配结果表明模型仅从图像即可表征该细胞身份。我们对 8 个病理基础模型和 3 个自然图像模型进行了评分。所有病理模型的得分均高于所有自然图像模型（0.299–0.371 对 0.214–0.232），配对检验在病理模型之间区分出三个层级。与有监督探针不同，BioScore 无需标签，其参照由数据构建，即使仅有少量切片也可评分，但对编码器的排序与探针一致。其按细胞身份的细分结果可指示每个编码器捕获或遗漏了哪些细胞身份。

title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
zh_title: Sage-Med：扩展医学多模态智能
summary: 发布35B参数（3B激活）医学多模态模型Sage-Med-Preview，经3.227亿候选记录筛选与渐进式训练，并系统评估现有医学MLLM的不足。
key_points: 现有医学MLLM在多项任务上弱于前沿通用MLLM
扩大规模主要提升文本而非多模态感知
采用预训练、分阶段SFT与自适应强化学习的课程
reason: 大规模医学多模态模型与系统评测，预印本，开放性未明，属重要档
abstract: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters, built by combining stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Across this curriculum, progressive supervised refinement and adaptive reinforcement learning yield consistent stage-wise gains, substantially advancing both specialized visual understanding and medical language capabilities. Evaluated against 77 competing models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks in more than 40 modalities, Sage-Med-Preview achieves an average score of 58.26% on the 31 public multimodal benchmarks. It outperforms the state-of-the-art open-source medical model Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 50.99% and the general scientific model Intern-S2-Preview at 52.24%, and approaches the advanced proprietary model GPT-6.2-Sol across multiple tasks such as comprehensive multimodal understanding, report generation, and visual grounding. Although substantial challenges remain in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows, this report provides empirical evidence, actionable data and training recipes, and a rigorous benchmark toward scalable clinical multimodal intelligence.
zh_abstract: 为医学多模态大语言模型（MLLM）建立有效的缩放定律，仍是一个长期存在的根本性挑战。我们的系统评估显示，现有医学 MLLM 在一系列医学任务上往往表现不及前沿通用 MLLM；扩大模型规模主要提升的是文本能力而非多模态感知，而启用推理模式也无法弥合这一视觉差距。为研究医学多模态智能在实践中如何缩放，我们提出 Sage-Med-Preview，这是一个拥有 35B 参数、激活参数为 3B 的医学多模态模型，其构建结合了对 3.227 亿条候选记录的分阶段数据整理，以及涵盖医学预训练、分阶段监督微调和自适应强化学习的渐进式训练课程。在该课程中，渐进式监督精炼与自适应强化学习带来了持续的阶段性提升，显著推进了专门的视觉理解和医学语言能力。在涵盖 40 余种模态、包含 61 个公开基准和 13 个私有多中心基准的 238 项临床任务上，与 77 个竞争模型比较，Sage-Med-Preview 在 31 个公开多模态基准上的平均得分为 58.26%。其表现优于最先进的开源医学模型 Hulu-Med-235B-A22B（50.99%）和通用科学模型 Intern-S2-Preview（52.24%），并在综合多模态理解、报告生成和视觉定位等多项任务上接近先进的专有模型 GPT-6.2-Sol。尽管在复杂医学推理和多步骤临床工作流程方面仍存在重大挑战，本报告为迈向可扩展的临床多模态智能提供了实证证据、可操作的数据与训练方案，以及一个严格的基准。

title: FDA Clears DeepHealth AI Tool for Five-Year Breast Cancer Risk Prediction From 3D Mammograms
zh_title: FDA批准DeepHealth基于3D乳腺钼靶的五年乳腺癌风险预测AI

abstract: [SLAS discovery : advancing life sciences R & D] Mechanism-of-action (MoA) analysis is used in drug discovery to prioritize compounds that act through desired pathways while eliminating compounds associated with nonspecific or undesirable activity. Image cytometry provides a promising route for MoA inference by capturing high-dimensional cellular phenotypes at single-cell resolution, but conventional workflows remain limited by unreliable cell segmentation and dependence on human-engineered feature extraction. Here, we present a deep learning-based image cytometry workflow that confines single cells in nanowells to obtain uniformly framed, regularized single-cell images, enabling MoA inference directly from raw images without segmentation or human-engineered features. Using a nanowell-in-microwell platform, we treated cells with 21 chemotherapeutic compounds spanning 11 MoA classes across multiple doses and time points, generating more than 500,000 single-cell images for model training and validation. A ResNet-18 convolutional neural network trained on images annotated by known compound mechanism achieved 85% accuracy in MoA classification. When a second model was trained on compound identity rather than MoA, misclassification patterns frequently linked compounds with shared mechanisms, indicating that the model learned mechanism-level relationships directly from single-cell morphology, without those relationships being specified in advance. Together, these results establish regularized single-cell imaging in nanowells as a scalable and interpretable approach to image-based MoA classification that overcomes key limitations of segmentation-dependent feature analysis.

abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] Ocular oncology sits in an unusual position for medical artificial intelligence (AI), imaging heavy and multimodal by nature, but constrained by the rarity of the tumours it treats. Uveal melanoma, the most common primary intraocular malignancy in adults, accounts for approximately 7095 new cases worldwide each year. Choroidal naevi are present in approximately 5% of the white population aged 40 and over, of which roughly 1 in 8845 transforms into melanoma each year, leaving a large benign population within which a small number of melanomas must not be missed. This narrative review follows the uveal melanoma clinical pathway through detection, diagnosis and prognosis, asking at each stage which class of AI model the evidence supports. A structured PubMed search returned 176 unique records, from which 29 primary studies were included, 17 (59%) published in 2025 or 2026. At detection, heavy self-supervised foundation models generalise well across imaging hardware but lack calibration to a clinical decision, while lightweight purpose-built classifiers show the opposite trade-off, and only one tool has been tested in a real referral workflow, quadrupling the odds of correct referral and cutting false positives 10-fold. At diagnosis, purpose-built convolutional classifiers calibrated to a referral threshold remain most mature, reaching 0.88 AUC on two cohorts, while multimodal fusion claims rest on a single 0.01 AUC gain. At prognosis, biomarker prediction from routine pathology reaches 0.93 to 0.99 AUC, survival prediction lags, only 7 of 29 studies (24%) had external validation and none of the tools has regulatory clearance.

title: Did the Model Forecast It, or Already Know It? Evaluating Large Language Models for Novel Drug-Target Prioritisation with a Temporal Knowledge-Graph Oracle
zh_title: 大模型是预测还是已知？基于时间知识图谱评估药物靶点优先级
summary: 用带日期的知识图谱评估六个开源语言模型预测下一年首个临床试验靶点-疾病对的能力，区分预测与记忆。

abstract: AI systems increasingly help decide which drug targets enter costly clinical trials. We recast each target-disease hypothesis as a dated event, the pair's first clinical trial. This lets us test whether a language model can forecast such events after its training cutoff, rather than recall events before it. We rebuild a dated biomedical knowledge graph as it stood at the end of each year from 2020 up to its newest version. We then ask six open language models, with and without this graph, which targets will enter a first trial for a disease the next year. Without retrieval, the models rank about as well as trial history, a count of each target's past trials in the same therapeutic area, also after their training cutoffs. Evidence dated before the decision adds at most a small gain, before or after the models' training cutoffs. The newest graph raises five of six models clearly above that baseline, but its paths usually include the answer: the pair's own trial, dated after the decision. Evaluations of target prioritisation should date both features and labels, with evidence from before the decision and outcomes after it.
zh_abstract: AI系统越来越多地协助决定哪些药物靶点进入昂贵的临床试验。我们将每个靶点-疾病假设重新表述为一个带日期的事件，即该配对的首次临床试验。这使我们能够检验语言模型能否预测其训练截止日期之后的此类事件，而非回忆截止日期之前的事件。我们重建了一个带日期的生物医学知识图谱，还原其在2020年至其最新版本期间每年年底的状态。随后，我们询问六个开源语言模型（分别在使用和不使用该图谱的情况下），哪些靶点将在次年进入某疾病的首次试验。在不使用检索时，这些模型的排序表现与试验历史（即每个靶点在同一治疗领域既往试验的计数）大致相当，在其训练截止日期之后亦然。决策之前的带日期证据至多带来很小的增益，无论在模型训练截止日期之前还是之后。最新的图谱使六个模型中的五个明显高于该基线，但其路径通常包含答案：即该配对自身的试验，其日期晚于决策。靶点优先级评估应同时为特征和标签标注日期，使用决策之前的证据和决策之后的结局。

title: DosePET: An Open-Source Dataset with 2100 Radiation Dose Maps for PET/CT

summary: 基于公开PET/CT经GATE蒙特卡洛模拟生成2100例患者特异性吸收剂量图，开源供核医学个体化剂量学AI研究。

abstract: Large collections of three-dimensional radiation dose maps linked to patient anatomy are needed to develop artificial intelligence (AI) models for personalized internal dosimetry in nuclear medicine, but access to such data remains limited. Here we present DosePET, an open-source dataset of 2,100 patient-specific absorbed-dose maps generated by Monte Carlo simulation of publicly available PET/CT examinations: 1,503 [18F]FDG examinations from ENHANCE.PET and 369 [18F]PSMA-1007 and 228 [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 examinations from PSMA-PET-CT-Lesions, acquired at five institutions with seven scanner models. For each examination, the CT was resampled to the native PET grid to build a voxelized patient phantom, the quantitative PET image defined the radionuclide source, and radiation transport was simulated with GATE version 9.4. Organ and tissue masks were generated from the CT with TotalSegmentator. Each study folder contains a NIfTI dose map integrated from scan time to infinity, 117 binary organ/tissue masks, a report of regional dosimetric quantities, including mean absorbed doses, dose conversion factors and scan-time dose rates, and simulation metadata. The total processing time was 1,542.4 hours. Python tools support selective downloading and conversion to scan-time dose-rate or dose-per-decay maps, and an agent skill guides pairing with the source PET/CT images. DosePET is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/eltzanis/DosePET.
zh_abstract: 开发用于核医学个体化内照射剂量学的人工智能（AI）模型，需要大量与患者解剖结构相关联的三维辐射剂量图，但此类数据的获取仍然有限。在此，我们介绍 DosePET，这是一个开源数据集，包含 2,100 份患者特异性吸收剂量图，由对公开可得的 PET/CT 检查进行蒙特卡罗模拟生成：其中 1,503 例 [18F]FDG 检查来自 ENHANCE.PET，369 例 [18F]PSMA-1007 检查和 228 例 [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 检查来自 PSMA-PET-CT-Lesions，这些检查在五家机构使用七种扫描仪型号采集。对于每例检查，将 CT 重采样至原始 PET 网格以构建体素化患者模体，以定量 PET 图像定义放射性核素源，并使用 GATE 9.4 版模拟辐射输运。器官和组织掩模由 TotalSegmentator 基于 CT 生成。每个研究文件夹包含：一幅从扫描时刻积分至无穷时间的 NIfTI 格式剂量图、117 个二值器官/组织掩模、一份区域剂量学量报告（包括平均吸收剂量、剂量转换因子和扫描时刻剂量率）以及模拟元数据。总处理时间为 1,542.4 小时。Python 工具支持选择性下载，并可转换为扫描时刻剂量率图或每次衰变剂量图，同时有一个 agent skill 指导与源 PET/CT 图像的配对。DosePET 已公开发布于 https://huggingface.co/datasets/eltzanis/DosePET。

title: CHD-Bench: Diagnosing Congenital Heart Disease through Interactive Examination
zh_title: CHD-Bench：通过交互式检查诊断先天性心脏病
summary: 提出首个交互式先天性心脏病诊断基准，含247例CT/MRI、38种类型，并开源让VLM在3D Slicer中调用工具的框架。

abstract: Diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD) requires understanding the spatial relationships between cardiac structures, which clinicians assess by scrolling through CT or cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) slices and rotating 3D reconstructions. Although automated methods have advanced cardiac segmentation, identifying congenital heart defects from volumetric scans remains an open challenge. The two existing approaches rely on handcrafted diagnostic rules limited to static anatomical abnormalities. We introduce CHD-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive CHD diagnosis, defining a multi-label task and evaluation protocol over 247 CT and MRI scans from three cohorts covering 38 CHD types. We also present CHD-Harness, open-source software that runs a VLM in a 3D Slicer environment through 22 tools, manages each examination, and records the resulting diagnosis and supporting views. We evaluate off-the-shelf medical, open weight, and closed weight VLMs and compare them with a 3D CNN classifier and published rule-based results. Gemini 4 Argon with CHD-Harness achieves the highest macro F1 across all three cohorts (0.63, 0.63, and 0.43). Allowing for interactive examination raises its macro F1 by up to 20 points over static views. These results establish CHD-Bench and CHD-Harness as a foundation for developing and evaluating VLMs for interactive CHD diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 先天性心脏病（CHD）的诊断需要理解心脏结构之间的空间关系，临床医生通过滚动浏览CT或心脏磁共振成像（MRI）切片并旋转三维重建图像来进行评估。尽管自动化方法已推动了心脏分割的发展，但从容积扫描中识别先天性心脏缺陷仍是一个尚未解决的挑战。现有的两种方法依赖于手工设计的诊断规则，仅限于静态解剖异常。我们提出了CHD-Bench，这是首个用于交互式CHD诊断的基准，针对来自三个队列、涵盖38种CHD类型的247例CT和MRI扫描，定义了多标签任务和评估方案。我们还提出了CHD-Harness，这是一款开源软件，可在3D Slicer环境中通过22种工具运行视觉语言模型（VLM），管理每次检查，并记录所得诊断及支持性视图。我们评估了现成的医学类、开放权重和闭源权重VLM，并将其与3D CNN分类器及已发表的基于规则的结果进行比较。搭载CHD-Harness的Gemini 4 Argon在全部三个队列中取得了最高的宏平均F1（分别为0.63、0.63和0.43）。允许交互式检查使其宏平均F1相比静态视图最多提高20个点。这些结果确立了CHD-Bench和CHD-Harness作为开发和评估用于交互式CHD诊断的VLM的基础。

title: MedSkill-E$^{2}$: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Medical Agents
zh_title: MedSkill-E²：医疗智能体技能的评估与演化
summary: 提出“技能可用但未充分使用”现象，构建覆盖12组医学任务的EBU-Bench，并提供评估与演化技能的框架。
key_points: 定义技能Enable But Underuse问题
EBU-Bench覆盖12类医学任务
以自主使用与明确引导的准确率差衡量差距
reason: 新基准与方法，医疗智能体方向，预印本，值得一看档
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills to access domain knowledge and complete real-world tasks. We observe that even when a skill specifies the rules and procedures needed for a task, agents may fail to apply them effectively during autonomous execution, a phenomenon we call skill Enable But Underuse (EBU). This issue is particularly consequential in medical tasks, where overlooking a single critical constraint can yield a plausible but incorrect result. To evaluate and address EBU, we introduce MedSkill-E$^{2}$, a framework for evaluating and evolving skills for medical agents. We construct EBU-Bench, a challenging benchmark covering 12 medically relevant task groups and associated skills, to evaluate agents' ability to use available skills autonomously. We quantify the EBU gap as the difference in skill-use accuracy between autonomous use and explicitly guided reading and application of the same skill. On EBU-Bench, all evaluated model-harness combinations exhibit EBU, with a mean gap of 43.94 percentage points (pp). For the same model, skill-use accuracy under autonomous use differs by up to 38.96 pp across harnesses. Motivated by these observations, we propose EBU-Evolve, which uses execution feedback from autonomous and explicitly guided skill use to distill effective guidance into reusable skill instructions. Relative to their pre-evolution versions, the revised skills improve skill-use accuracy during autonomous execution by 33.33 to 55.17 pp and continue to yield improvements when transferred across multiple models and harnesses. Our results show that autonomous skill-use accuracy varies across harnesses with the model and skill held fixed, and model rankings can change. EBU can persist even after a skill is opened. EBU-Evolve improves autonomous skill-use accuracy on unseen tasks within the same skill, with gains transferring across models and harnesses.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地利用技能（skill）获取领域知识并完成现实任务。我们观察到，即使某项技能已规定任务所需的规则和流程，智能体在自主执行过程中也可能无法有效应用它们，我们将这一现象称为技能“可用但未充分使用”（Enable But Underuse，EBU）。这一问题在医学任务中尤为重要，因为忽略单个关键约束就可能得到看似合理但错误的结果。为评估并解决 EBU，我们提出了 MedSkill-E$^{2}$，一个用于评估和演化医学智能体技能的框架。我们构建了 EBU-Bench，这是一个具有挑战性的基准，涵盖 12 个与医学相关的任务组及相关技能，用于评估智能体自主使用可用技能的能力。我们将 EBU 差距量化为同一技能在自主使用与明确引导下阅读并应用之间的技能使用准确率之差。在 EBU-Bench 上，所有被评估的模型-框架（harness）组合均表现出 EBU，平均差距为 43.94 个百分点（pp）。对于同一模型，不同框架下自主使用的技能使用准确率相差最多达 38.96 pp。受这些观察启发，我们提出 EBU-Evolve，利用自主使用和明确引导使用技能的执行反馈，将有效指导提炼为可复用的技能说明。与演化前的版本相比，修订后的技能使自主执行时的技能使用准确率提高 33.33 至 55.17 pp，并且在迁移到多个模型和框架时仍持续带来提升。我们的结果表明，在模型和技能固定的情况下，自主技能使用准确率会随框架而变化，且模型排名可能改变。即使技能已被打开，EBU 仍可能持续存在。EBU-Evolve 可提高同一技能内未见任务上的自主技能使用准确率，且收益可在不同模型和框架之间迁移。

title: Can Its Own Misses Teach an MLLM to Find Small Brain Metastases?
zh_title: LANTERN：让MLLM从自身漏检中学习发现微小脑转移灶
summary: 提出LANTERN框架，通过漏检归因与LLM导师逐轮修订，让多模态大模型递归改进小脑转移灶检测。
key_points: 指出前沿MLLM对0.1-1 mL病灶召回低于30%
漏检归因为四类原因，LLM导师每轮修订一个层级

abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are becoming general readers of medical images, yet they remain weak at locating small abnormalities. Brain metastases expose this gap: at 384 px a 0.1 mL lesion covers less than a quarter of one visual token, and at one false positive per scan frontier MLLMs find fewer than 30% of lesions of 0.1-1 mL. Fine-tuning on one dataset helps but transfers poorly, and improving it further is slow trial and error steered by a single score. We introduce LANTERN (Lesion-finding AgeNt Through Error-driven Recursive learNing), a framework in which an MLLM improves recursively from its own misses. LANTERN recasts model development as an error-driven loop: a failure census attributes every missed lesion to one of four causes, an LLM mentor revises one of four levels (evidence acquisition, visual representation, learning policy, decision aggregation) per round, and a rule frozen before the first round decides what is kept, without test data and with every tool call audited. Over 15 unattended rounds, LANTERN raises a fine-tuned 4B MLLM from finding 75% to 94% of lesions at one false positive per scan on BraTS-MET, and 91% of those of 0.1-1 mL, compared with at most 51% and 29% for five frontier MLLMs read under the starting protocol; the gains hold on an external cohort (89%) and on unseen meningiomas (77%). These results show that an MLLM's own misses, attributed to their causes, can drive its reliable recursive self-improvement.

title: What, Who, and When: Structured Harm Assessment for Mental Health Safety via Short Reasoning
zh_title: 心理健康安全的结构化伤害评估：what、who、when
summary: 提出临床依据的三维伤害分类体系，并通过简短推理评估LLM心理健康支持中的伤害，安全策略可外置于模型权重。

abstract: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support raises important safety concerns. Existing guard models primarily identify categories of harmful content, often overlooking the context needed to determine an appropriate response. We introduce a clinically grounded taxonomy that characterizes harm along three dimensions: what the harm is, who is involved, and when it occurs. It further separates harm characterization from intervention decisions, thus enabling safety policies to be specified outside the model weights through explicit, clinician-curated instructions that can be updated and audited. We validate the taxonomy with expert clinicians and validate a panel of LLM judges to scale annotation. Relabeling public benchmarks in this taxonomy shows that they rarely contain harm directed at the user, which accounts for nearly half of the harm in real conversations. We then train MindGuard2, a 35B-A3B reasoning-based guard model using supervised fine-tuning on short reasoning traces followed by reinforcement learning with a reasoning-length penalty, to minimize inference overhead while preserving the benefits of reasoning. On two public benchmarks and real-world conversations, MindGuard2 achieves balanced accuracy comparable to the substantially larger GLM-5.3 at approximately 10x lower median latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. Furthermore, it achieves low false-positive rates at high recall, helping balance the need to detect unsafe situations against the risk of unnecessary interventions that may disrupt support and undermine user trust. We release a safety guardrail model with SOTA performance trained on synthetic data, together with synthetic conversations and annotations of public benchmarks in our taxonomy.
zh_abstract: 越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）提供心理健康支持，引发了重要的安全性关切。现有的防护模型主要识别有害内容的类别，往往忽视了确定恰当应对方式所需的情境。我们提出一种以临床为基础的分类体系，从三个维度刻画伤害：伤害是什么、涉及谁、何时发生。该体系进一步将伤害刻画与干预决策分离，从而使安全策略能够通过由临床医生制定的显式指令在模型权重之外加以规定，并可更新和审计。我们通过专家临床医生验证了该分类体系，并验证了一组 LLM 评判器以扩大标注规模。按该分类体系对公开基准重新标注后发现，这些基准很少包含针对用户的伤害，而这类伤害占真实对话中伤害的近一半。随后我们训练了 MindGuard2，这是一个 35B-A3B 的基于推理的防护模型，先在简短推理轨迹上进行监督微调，再进行带有推理长度惩罚的强化学习，以在保留推理优势的同时尽量减少推理开销。在两个公开基准和真实对话上，MindGuard2 取得了与规模大得多的 GLM-5.3 相当的平衡准确率，而中位延迟约低 10 倍，推进了准确率—延迟的帕累托前沿。此外，它在高召回率下实现了较低的假阳性率，有助于在检测不安全情形的需求与可能干扰支持并损害用户信任的不必要干预风险之间取得平衡。我们发布了一个基于合成数据训练、性能达到 SOTA 的安全防护模型，以及合成对话和按我们的分类体系对公开基准所做的标注。

title: Rank Before You Encode: Reading a Few Percent of a Whole-Slide Image
zh_title: 先排序再编码：仅读取全切片图像的少量区域
summary: 用仅3.3K参数的轻量选择器拟合冻结模型注意力，从缩略图选取少量区域编码，在相同编码成本下对比随机采样及九种高效方法。
key_points: 保持冻结全bag模型，仅对选中tile运行
选择器无需额外切片标签，由缩略图排序区域
在七种MIL聚合器、六项任务上评估
reason: 病理WSI效率新方法，对比充分，预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Classifying a whole-slide image requires encoding thousands of high-resolution tiles with a pathology foundation model, which accounts for most of the inference cost. Existing efficient methods reduce this cost by selecting fewer tiles, but typically train a new model around their selection strategy. A largely unexplored alternative is to keep an existing full-bag model frozen and run it on selected tiles at the same encoder cost. We introduce this comparison, alongside random tile sampling at matched cost. To select tiles, we fit a lightweight selector with 3.3K parameters to the attention of a frozen model, without additional slide labels. The selector ranks regions from a slide thumbnail, encodes the top K regions at 5x magnification, and selects b for processing at 20x. We evaluate seven frozen MIL aggregators on six tasks and compare them with nine efficient methods trained on the same features and splits. At a budget of (K,b)=(1000,10), encoding costs about 6.6% of the full bag and is 10-14x faster, excluding tiling. The AUROC drop is no more than 0.005 in 33 of 36 aggregator-task pairs. At (500,10), the cost falls to about 4% and inference is 13-22x faster, but AUROC drops by up to 0.035 on CAMELYON17, where small metastases are easily missed. Selection improves over random sampling by about 0.10 AUROC on tasks with focal lesions, while random sampling performs well on diffuse tasks. In our comparisons, the frozen model at (500,10) is ahead of nine efficient methods in 55 of 60 paired comparisons. Giving an existing WSI model fewer tiles is thus a baseline that a new efficient model should be compared with at matched encoder cost.
zh_abstract: 对全切片图像（whole-slide image）进行分类，需要用病理基础模型对数千个高分辨率图块（tile）进行编码，而这占据了推理成本的大部分。现有的高效方法通过选择更少的图块来降低这一成本，但通常需要围绕其选择策略训练新的模型。一种基本未被探索的替代方案是：保持现有的完整图块包（full-bag）模型冻结，并在相同的编码器成本下仅对选定图块运行该模型。我们提出了这一比较，并同时设置了成本匹配的随机图块采样作为对照。为选择图块，我们将一个仅含3.3K参数的轻量级选择器拟合到冻结模型的注意力上，无需额外的切片标签。该选择器根据切片缩略图对区域进行排序，在5倍放大倍率下编码排名前K的区域，并选出b个在20倍放大倍率下进行处理。我们在六项任务上评估了七种冻结的多示例学习（MIL）聚合器，并将其与在相同特征和数据划分上训练的九种高效方法进行比较。在预算为(K,b)=(1000,10)时，编码成本约为完整图块包的6.6%，速度提高10–14倍（不含图块切分）。在36个聚合器-任务组合中，有33个的AUROC下降不超过0.005。在(500,10)时，成本降至约4%，推理速度提高13–22倍，但在CAMELYON17上AUROC最多下降0.035，因为小转移灶容易被漏掉。在存在局灶性病变的任务上，选择策略比随机采样的AUROC提高约0.10，而在弥漫性任务上随机采样表现良好。在我们的比较中，(500,10)下的冻结模型在60组配对比较中有55组领先于九种高效方法。因此，让现有的WSI模型使用更少的图块，是新的高效模型应在匹配编码器成本下与之比较的一个基线。

title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Immediate and Prospective Credit Assignment for Medical Visual Reasoning
zh_title: MedPACT：面向医学视觉推理的智能体强化学习
summary: 提出MedPACT，在GRPO中结合即时与前瞻性观察信用分配，训练单一视觉语言模型进行医学VQA中的选择性观察。
key_points: 对比真实与替代观察以估计信用
信用分配到工具调用token
仅训练时估计信用，单一VLM
reason: 新颖的医学VLM智能体RL方法，有基线对比但证据有限
abstract: Medical visual question answering (VQA) requires acquiring useful evidence and deciding where to look next. Yet final-answer rewards do not reveal which observations support answering or guide subsequent inspection. We introduce MedPACT, an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns selective observation policies through immediate answer support and prospective guidance. Our content-controlled estimator compares next actions induced by real and matched alternative observations under a shared real-observation history, isolating how observed content improves subsequent decisions. We combine both forms of credit within GRPO, assigning observation credit to the corresponding tool-call tokens alongside trajectory-level outcome supervision. MedPACT uses a single vision-language model and image-question-answer supervision, with credit estimation confined to training. Experiments with 4B and 8B backbones on six medical VQA benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy, strong out-of-distribution generalization, and substantially lower inference costs. Case studies further illustrate how MedPACT avoids repeated observations and uses acquired evidence to guide subsequent inspection, demonstrating real-world practice potential.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉问答（VQA）需要获取有用的证据并决定下一步看向何处。然而，最终答案奖励并不能揭示哪些观察支持作答，也无法指导后续检查。我们提出了MedPACT，一种智能体强化学习框架，通过即时答案支持和前瞻性指导来学习选择性观察策略。我们的内容受控估计器在共享的真实观察历史下，比较由真实观察与匹配的替代观察所引发的下一步动作，从而分离出所观察内容如何改善后续决策。我们在GRPO中结合这两种形式的信用，将观察信用分配给相应的工具调用token，并与轨迹级结果监督相结合。MedPACT使用单一视觉-语言模型和图像-问题-答案监督，信用估计仅限于训练阶段。在六个医学VQA基准上使用4B和8B骨干网络的实验表明，其准确率提高、分布外泛化能力强，且推理成本大幅降低。案例研究进一步说明了MedPACT如何避免重复观察，并利用已获取的证据指导后续检查，显示出真实世界实践的潜力。

title: Typical Angina, Reversed: A Long-Standing Documentation Error in the UCI Heart Disease Data
zh_title: UCI心脏病数据集胸痛变量编码与文档相反
summary: 指出广泛使用的UCI心脏病数据中胸痛变量编码与文档相反，编码4实为典型心绞痛，并通过复现1986年研究与特征核查验证。
key_points: 四个站点均存在编码反转
93–96%编码4者具备三项典型特征
OpenML、PMLB等副本沿用该编码
reason: 影响广泛使用基准的数据质量问题，有实证核查
abstract: The UCI Heart Disease data are a widely used machine-learning benchmark. We show that their chest-pain variable is stored in reverse of its documentation. At all four sites, the code documented as "asymptomatic" (4) marks patients with typical angina, and the code documented as "typical angina" (1) marks patients with almost none of the classical angina features (at Cleveland, no chest pain). Two complementary checks establish this: (i) the chest-pain table and regression coefficients of the original 1986 Cleveland study are reproduced only under the corrected reading; (ii) in the Budapest, Switzerland and Long Beach files, 93-96% of patients coded 4 have all three classical angina features. A 1990 word-labeled Cleveland file already uses the documented labels, and Statlog (Heart), a Cleveland subset, stores the same codes. OpenML, PMLB and two highly voted Kaggle copies that name the categories use the same documented labels (about 400,000 downloads combined). We audited a seeded random sample of 150 records from a pre-specified Scholar query for SHAP studies of these data mentioning asymptomatic chest pain (124 readable). Of 32 papers that state a direction for a named category, 25 (78%; 95% CI 61-89%) state one inconsistent with the corrected category identities; 22 (69%; 51-82%; post hoc) are attributable to the documentation error, and nine of these explain it clinically. None of the 124 readable papers identifies the reversal. Conventional models are essentially unaffected, one reason the error went unnoticed. Interpretations that attach the documented names to model effects are reversed, and zero-shot language-model classifiers that read the labels are misled: with the documented labels, three open-weight models lose 0.12-0.33 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) given age, sex and chest-pain type. We give the corrected mapping, evidence and code.
zh_abstract: UCI 心脏病数据是广泛使用的机器学习基准数据集。我们表明，其胸痛变量的存储编码与其文档说明相反。在全部四个中心，文档中标注为“无症状”（asymptomatic）的编码 4 标记的是具有典型心绞痛的患者，而文档中标注为“典型心绞痛”的编码 1 标记的是几乎没有任何经典心绞痛特征的患者（在 Cleveland，为无胸痛）。两项互补检验证实了这一点：（i）1986 年 Cleveland 原始研究的胸痛表和回归系数仅在采用更正后的解读时才能复现；（ii）在 Budapest、Switzerland 和 Long Beach 文件中，编码为 4 的患者有 93–96% 具备全部三项经典心绞痛特征。1990 年带文字标签的 Cleveland 文件已使用文档所述的标签，而 Cleveland 子集 Statlog (Heart) 存储的是相同编码。OpenML、PMLB 以及两个命名了类别的高票 Kaggle 副本使用相同的文档所述标签（合计约 400,000 次下载）。我们对一个预先指定的 Scholar 检索（针对提及无症状胸痛的、使用这些数据的 SHAP 研究）所得结果，按种子随机抽取 150 条记录进行审核（124 篇可读）。在 32 篇对某一命名类别陈述了方向的论文中，25 篇（78%；95% CI 61–89%）所陈述的方向与更正后的类别含义不一致；22 篇（69%；51–82%；事后分析）可归因于文档错误，其中 9 篇对此做了临床解释。124 篇可读论文中没有一篇指出该反转。传统模型基本不受影响，这是该错误未被察觉的原因之一。将文档所述名称对应到模型效应的解释会被颠倒，而读取标签的零样本语言模型分类器也会被误导：使用文档所述标签时，三个开放权重模型在给定年龄、性别和胸痛类型的情况下，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）下降 0.12–0.33。我们给出了更正后的映射、证据和代码。

title: CariesBench: A Hierarchical Multi-view Benchmark for Dental Caries Screening and Diagnostic Reasoning from 3D Intraoral Scans
zh_title: CariesBench：基于3D口扫的龋齿筛查与诊断推理分层多视角基准
summary: 基于5,932份3D口内扫描构建分层多视角基准（85,455张渲染图），用于评估多模态大模型在龋齿定位、牙面及严重度推理上的能力。
key_points: 覆盖牙弓到牙齿再到牙面的分层推理
含跨视角证据整合评估
面向多模态大语言模型评测
reason: 新的多模态医学基准、规模较大，但为预印本且专科较窄
abstract: Dental caries assessment is a structured clinical process requiring lesion localization, identification of the affected tooth and surface, and severity grading rather than simple image-level recognition. 3D intraoral scans (IOS) preserve detailed dental geometry and surface morphology and support standardized rendering from complementary viewpoints, enabling fine-grained visual assessment while introducing a distinct need for anatomically grounded multi-view reasoning. Despite recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and dental vision-language benchmarks, existing evaluations do not jointly assess hierarchical arch-to-tooth-to-surface reasoning, cross-view evidence integration, and surface-level caries assessment. To address this gap, we introduce CariesBench, a hierarchical benchmark constructed from 5,932 3D IOS, comprising 85,455 standardized multi-view renderings and 133,994 clinically grounded visual question answering instances with expert quality control. CariesBench comprises three complementary task families: Arch-level Clinical Screening (ACS), Tooth-level Diagnostic Reasoning (TDR), and Structured Clinical Decision-Making (SCD). Using the CariesBench training set, we further fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct to obtain IntraoralGPT. Extensive evaluation of 24 representative baseline MLLMs reveals a substantial benchmark-level performance disparity between arch-level screening and tooth-level diagnostic reasoning, with higher accuracy on ACS than on TDR. CariesBench-specific supervision substantially improves the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline, increasing the 19-task macro-average clinical accuracy from 52.7% to 69.5% and TDR Overall from 34.4% to 44.7%.

title: Evidence-Aligned Benchmarking and Learning for Medical Video Language Models
zh_title: 医学视频语言模型的证据对齐基准与学习（MedEvidU）
summary: 指出现有医学视频问答基准可不看视频作答，提出 MedVidBench-v2（34 项任务、18 个数据集）及查询槽输入方法，使模型依据视觉证据作答。
key_points: 发现某数据集中片段位置可预测 37% 手术步骤问题
新基准用无视频作答审核提示与指标，并测试未见医院
查询槽输入为每个被问帧提供独立 token，额外开销很小
reason: 新基准覆盖多数据集并含未见医院测试，但为预印本；多模态与手术视频加分
abstract: A medical video language model should answer from the visual evidence its question asks about. We find three places where this breaks down and address each with an approach we call MedEvidU. First, benchmarks reward answers that ignore the video: on one dataset, the position of a clip within its recording predicts the surgical step in 37% of questions, and a constant answer beats every trained model on a standard safety-assessment metric. We build MedVidBench-v2, 34 tasks from 18 surgical and clinical video datasets, in which prompts and metrics are audited with answers given without video, and which tests unseen hospitals and windows cut blindly from whole recordings. Second, common video encoders merge consecutive frames into shared tokens, so a question about one frame is answered from a blend of two. Query-slot inputs give each queried frame its own tokens at almost no extra cost. Third, a fine-tuned model has memorized its training questions, which leaves little to learn from. Label-matched question resampling (LQR) adds unseen questions about the same recordings while keeping the answer distribution fixed, in a final supervised epoch and in reinforcement learning. Together, these raise the grounding IoU of a 4B model from 30.4 to 44.4, above a supervised 27B model, and instrument grounding at an unseen hospital from 33.9 to 72.5. On blindly cut windows, event-presence accuracy improves by 5.5 points and localization F1 by 8.1 points. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/MedEvidU/

title: An interpretable framework for decoding transcriptomic foundation models
zh_title: 转录组基础模型的可解释框架interpreTFM
summary: 用稀疏自编码器分解冻结的转录组基础模型激活，在空间转录组数据上检验概念特征是否真正表征概念，发现对未见基因泛化较差。
key_points: 应用于CosMx肺癌与Xenium肾癌数据
随机初始化的scGPT/Geneformer表现相近
留出基因的概念F1仅0.01–0.12
reason: 基础模型可解释性，有批判性发现但属预印本
abstract: Background: What transcriptomic foundation models encode, and how well they describe cells and tissue on targeted spatial panels, is under-explored. It is unclear whether a concept-labeled sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature represents its concept or only the genes it detects. Results: Here, we propose interpreTFM, which decomposes frozen transcriptomic foundation model activations with SAEs. We applied it to a CosMx lung-cancer section, four further CosMx donors, and a Xenium renal-cell-carcinoma section. On held-out tokens of known genes, sparse features marked 262--593 concepts per analysis layer, and SAEs of re-initialized scGPT and Geneformer did as well. On held-out genes, concept F1 was 0.01--0.12 for every representation and lowest for sparse features. A linear probe of hidden states predicted the concepts of unseen genes, but only in trained models. Per cell, sparse features reached 66--98% of single-gene population specificity (57--110% in the donors). In the analyzed CosMx section, sparse-feature niches matched author cell types at ARI 0.34--0.42, while expression-only niches reached 0.30; in the donors, their defining concepts recurred but their composition did not. In Xenium, the niches shared by all models were recovered from expression alone. Calibrated model interface calls were at chance in CosMx and tracked transcript spillover in Xenium. Conclusions: On these panels, SAE features act as concept-labeled gene detectors, while learned concept information is distributed across hidden dimensions. Concept labels should be checked against held-out genes and re-initialized models. For cells and niches, the features give named descriptions, comparable across models and patients and bounded by the measured panel.
zh_abstract:
【背景】转录组基础模型编码了什么，以及它们在靶向空间转录组panel上对细胞和组织的描述能力如何，目前尚未得到充分探讨。目前尚不清楚带有概念标签的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征究竟代表其所对应的概念，还是仅代表其所检测的基因。
【结果】在此，我们提出 interpreTFM，其利用SAE分解冻结的转录组基础模型的激活。我们将其应用于一张CosMx肺癌切片、另外四位CosMx供者样本以及一张Xenium肾细胞癌切片。在已知基因的留出token上，稀疏特征在每个分析层标记了262–593个概念，而重新初始化的scGPT和Geneformer的SAE表现相当。在留出基因上，所有表示的概念F1为0.01–0.12，其中稀疏特征最低。对隐藏状态进行线性探针可预测未见基因的概念，但仅限于经过训练的模型。在单细胞水平上，稀疏特征达到单基因群体特异性的66–98%（供者中为57–110%）。在所分析的CosMx切片中，稀疏特征生态位与作者标注细胞类型的ARI为0.34–0.42，而仅基于表达的生态位为0.30；在供者中，其定义性概念会重复出现，但其构成并不一致。在Xenium中，所有模型共有的生态位仅凭表达即可恢复。经校准的模型接口调用在CosMx中处于随机水平，在Xenium中则与转录本溢出（spillover）一致。
【结论】在这些panel上，SAE特征表现为带概念标签的基因检测器，而学到的概念信息分布于各隐藏维度中。概念标签应通过留出基因和重新初始化模型加以检验。对于细胞和生态位，这些特征提供了有名称的描述，可在不同模型和患者之间比较，并受限于所测量的panel。

title: A noise-corrected metric for evaluating spatial transcriptomics predicted from histology
zh_title: 评估组织学预测空间转录组的噪声校正指标
summary: 提出RSC指标，分离可重复信号与采样噪声；评估12种斑点级和3种单细胞方法，发现多数模型仅捕捉粗略组织模式。
key_points: RSC随机拆分RNA计数去噪
多数模型难区分相邻斑点差异
评估15种方法
reason: 新评估指标、对比充分，但为预印本
abstract: Deep learning methods that predict spatial transcriptomics from histology offer scalable molecular profiling of clinical cohorts. However, conventional correlation metrics overstate prediction quality across whole sections by crediting models for recognizing broad tissue regions, and understate fine-scale prediction quality because sampling noise dominates sparse RNA counts. To resolve this, we introduce the reproducible-signal correlation (RSC) metric. RSC randomly splits RNA counts into two halves to separate reproducible signal from sampling noise across spatial scales and within tissue regions or cell classes. Across 12 spot-level and three single-cell methods, RSC revealed that most models capture broad tissue patterns but largely miss differences between neighboring spots or cells, which whole-section correlation overlooks. Within malignant cells, RSC distinguished methods that genuinely capture part of the cell-to-cell heterogeneity from those whose scores across all cells were inflated by cell-type composition. Guided by RSC, we designed a pairwise difference loss between neighboring spots that improved fine-scale predictions on average across 11 models. RSC thus provides a foundation for benchmarking predictions, guiding model design and determining which spatial analyses histology can support.
zh_abstract: 从组织学图像预测空间转录组的深度学习方法可为临床队列提供可扩展的分子谱分析。然而，传统的相关性指标会因模型能识别大范围组织区域而高估整张切片的预测质量，同时又因采样噪声主导稀疏的RNA计数而低估精细尺度的预测质量。为解决这一问题，我们提出了可重复信号相关性（reproducible-signal correlation，RSC）指标。RSC将RNA计数随机分为两半，以在不同空间尺度以及组织区域或细胞类别内部区分可重复信号与采样噪声。在12种基于点（spot）水平的方法和3种单细胞方法中，RSC显示大多数模型能捕捉大范围的组织模式，但在很大程度上无法捕捉相邻点或细胞之间的差异，而整张切片相关性忽略了这一点。在恶性细胞内部，RSC可区分真正捕捉到部分细胞间异质性的方法与其全部细胞得分因细胞类型构成而被夸大的方法。在RSC指导下，我们设计了相邻点之间的成对差异损失，平均而言改善了11个模型的精细尺度预测。因此，RSC为预测基准评估、指导模型设计以及确定组织学可支持哪些空间分析提供了基础。

title: LingSante MedGuard Technical Report
zh_title: LingSante MedGuard技术报告：医学护栏模型
summary: 提出能力增强的医学护栏模型，将护栏教师模型与六个专项能力专家整合，用于识别医疗AI回答中的有害、不合规或伦理问题。
key_points: 教师模型监督安全、合规、伦理风险判断
六类专家含数值推理、多模态幻觉检测
面向医疗AI负责任部署
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，摘要未见评测细节
abstract: As medical AI is increasingly used for patient consultation and clinical decision support, identifying harmful, non-compliant, or ethically problematic responses is essential for responsible deployment. Assessing these risks requires checking clinical claims against relevant evidence, verifying calculations, and applying medical requirements under their intended conditions. We introduce LingSante MedGuard, a capability-enhanced guardrail that integrates supervision from a medical guardrail teacher model and six specialized medical capability experts into a unified model. The guardrail teacher supervises risk decisions and explanations across medical safety, compliance, and ethics, while the capability experts support medical rule understanding, numerical reasoning, multimodal hallucination detection, agentic safety verification, risk localization, and multimodal entity understanding. We consolidate these sources of supervision through offline supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated demonstrations, followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation using feedback on student-generated responses. We further introduce LingSante MedGuardBench, a benchmark comprising 11 risk-detection subsets spanning medical safety, compliance, and ethics. At 4B, 9B, and 27B scales, LingSante MedGuard achieves mean benchmark F1 scores of 82.3%, 82.4%, and 87.4%, respectively. The 4B model also achieves 73.9% mean accuracy across MedHallu and MedHALT-NOTA under retrieval-enabled evaluation. Additional evaluations of the verification components show improvements in evidence-supported consistency, source traceability, and rule-guided rationale quality across model scales. These results support the integration of specialized medical capabilities into a unified guardrail for medical risk assessment and evidence-based medical safety verification.
zh_abstract: 随着医疗人工智能越来越多地用于患者咨询和临床决策支持，识别有害、不合规或存在伦理问题的回答，对于负责任地部署至关重要。评估这些风险需要将临床论断与相关证据进行核对、验证计算，并在预期条件下应用医学要求。我们提出了 LingSante MedGuard，这是一种能力增强型护栏模型，它将来自一个医疗护栏教师模型和六个专业医学能力专家的监督整合到一个统一模型中。护栏教师负责监督医疗安全、合规和伦理方面的风险判定及解释，而能力专家则支持医学规则理解、数值推理、多模态幻觉检测、智能体（agentic）安全验证、风险定位和多模态实体理解。我们通过两步整合这些监督来源：先基于教师生成的示范进行离线监督微调，随后利用对学生模型生成回答的反馈进行多教师在线策略（on-policy）蒸馏。我们还提出了 LingSante MedGuardBench，这是一个包含11个风险检测子集的基准，涵盖医疗安全、合规和伦理。在4B、9B和27B规模下，LingSante MedGuard 的基准平均F1分数分别为82.3%、82.4%和87.4%。在启用检索的评估条件下，4B模型在 MedHallu 和 MedHALT-NOTA 上的平均准确率也达到73.9%。对验证组件的进一步评估显示，在各模型规模下，证据支持的一致性、来源可追溯性以及规则引导的推理依据质量均有所提升。这些结果支持将专业医学能力整合到统一护栏中，用于医疗风险评估和基于证据的医疗安全验证。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Social work informatics (SWI) was proposed as a professional specialty in 2006, yet social work remains under-represented in health informatics governance, research, and system design even as artificial intelligence (AI) shapes high-stakes clinical decisions. This paper introduces the SWI Equity Framework, positioning social work as a leader in designing equitable health informatics systems. The framework was developed through a synthesis of social work, health informatics, and health equity literature. The framework identifies 6 domains: reflexive system co-design, social determinants of health data integration, training-data quality and representation, contextual interpretation of AI outputs, community leadership, and equitable accountability. The framework highlights opportunities to integrate social work expertise throughout the health informatics lifecycle, moving beyond consultation toward active participation in system design, implementation, and governance. It also outlines pathways for advancing social work informatics through education, interdisciplinary research, health systems, and professional infrastructure. Social work is particularly well positioned to advance the equity agenda of health informatics and offers profession-specific expertise that can strengthen equity, accountability, and implementation across the informatics lifecycle.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 社会工作信息学（SWI）于2006年被提出作为一个专业方向，然而即使人工智能（AI）正在影响高风险的临床决策，社会工作在健康信息学的治理、研究和系统设计中的代表性仍然不足。本文提出了SWI公平框架，将社会工作定位为设计公平的健康信息学系统的引领者。该框架通过综合社会工作、健康信息学和健康公平方面的文献而形成。该框架确定了6个领域：反思性系统共同设计、健康社会决定因素数据整合、训练数据质量与代表性、对AI输出的情境化解读、社区领导，以及公平的问责。该框架强调了在整个健康信息学生命周期中整合社会工作专业知识的机会，从提供咨询转向积极参与系统的设计、实施和治理。它还概述了通过教育、跨学科研究、卫生系统和专业基础设施推进社会工作信息学的路径。社会工作特别适合推进健康信息学的公平议程，并能提供专业特有的专长，以加强整个信息学生命周期中的公平性、问责和实施。

abstract: [Journal of dentistry] To distinguish what dental artificial intelligence (AI) models demonstrate from what their findings are claimed to mean, and to offer a framework for matching each claim to the evidence required to support it. AI studies in dentistry report sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve: measures of agreement between model outputs and a reference standard. Yet verbs such as predict, detect, identify, and explain are used interchangeably, and outputs are often read as identifying modifiable causes or as evidence of clinical benefit. Using the causal hierarchy of association, intervention, and counterfactual reasoning, this review separates description, prediction, causal effects of interventions, and individual counterfactuals. Directed acyclic graphs illustrate how confounding by indication can make an effective treatment appear harmful in a predictive model. The review summarizes the identification conditions that causal claims require (exchangeability, positivity, consistency) and where AI can legitimately contribute: measurement, nuisance-function estimation, heterogeneous treatment effects, and hypothesis-generating causal discovery. Model-explanation methods describe how a fitted model behaves, not how patients would respond to intervention. A published caries-detection model illustrates the evidence needed to move from diagnostic accuracy to claims about clinician decisions and patient outcomes. Most AI models developed for prediction operate at the association level. Model complexity and dataset size cannot substitute for a defined intervention, an appropriate design, and defensible identification assumptions. Dental AI accuracy studies show agreement with a reference standard, not that using the tool improves decisions or patient outcomes. Such claims require comparative evaluation of AI-assisted care.
zh_abstract: [Journal of dentistry] 旨在区分牙科人工智能（AI）模型所展示的内容与其研究结果被声称的含义，并提供一个框架，使每项声称与支持它所需的证据相匹配。牙科 AI 研究报告敏感性、特异性和曲线下面积：这些是模型输出与参考标准之间一致性的度量。然而，“预测”“检测”“识别”和“解释”等动词被互换使用，输出结果常被解读为识别出了可改变的病因，或被当作临床获益的证据。本综述利用关联、干预和反事实推理的因果层级，区分描述、预测、干预的因果效应以及个体反事实。有向无环图说明了适应证混杂如何使一种有效治疗在预测模型中看起来有害。本综述总结了因果声称所需的识别条件（可交换性、正值性、一致性），以及 AI 可以合理发挥作用的方面：测量、干扰函数估计、异质性治疗效应和产生假设的因果发现。模型解释方法描述的是已拟合模型的行为，而非患者对干预的反应。一个已发表的龋齿检测模型说明了从诊断准确性推进到关于临床医生决策和患者结局的声称所需的证据。大多数为预测而开发的 AI 模型在关联层面运作。模型复杂性和数据集规模无法替代明确界定的干预、适当的设计以及站得住脚的识别假设。牙科 AI 准确性研究显示的是与参考标准的一致性，而不是使用该工具能改善决策或患者结局。此类声称需要对 AI 辅助诊疗进行比较性评估。

abstract: [Pharmacological research] AI methods are used in proteolysis-targeting chimera (PROTAC) discovery for candidate generation, ternary-complex modelling and property prediction. These tasks are organised here into Designer, Connector and Predictor roles to examine how computational outputs can inform experimental decisions in cancer drug discovery. Published studies connect selected computationally generated compounds to biological testing and show how new measurements can inform chemical optimisation and property-model refinement. Case studies of linker modifications and PKMYT1 stereoisomers illustrate discrepancies between binding and cellular degradation. Further preclinical and clinical findings show why target depletion must be interpreted alongside pathway suppression, tissue exposure and tolerability. The analysis identifies measurements that could distinguish competing explanations and guide changes to candidate chemistry, structural hypotheses, prediction models or experimental conditions. Predictive performance depends on chemical and biological context, so validation needs to reflect the compounds, targets and endpoints encountered in the intended application. Exposure-response models can help interpret pharmacological findings when supported by relevant tissue and pathway measurements. Clinical outcomes are also distinguished from evidence of AI involvement in individual candidates. Current evidence supports specific connections between computation and experiment. Prospective comparisons are needed to determine whether coordinating these methods improves candidate selection and pharmacological outcomes.
zh_abstract: [药理学研究] 人工智能（AI）方法被用于蛋白降解靶向嵌合体（PROTAC）的发现，涉及候选分子生成、三元复合物建模和性质预测。本文将这些任务归纳为“设计者（Designer）”“连接者（Connector）”和“预测者（Predictor）”三种角色，以探讨计算输出如何为癌症药物发现中的实验决策提供依据。已发表的研究将部分经计算生成的化合物与生物学检测联系起来，并显示新的测量结果如何为化学结构优化和性质模型的改进提供依据。关于连接子修饰和 PKMYT1 立体异构体的案例研究说明了结合与细胞内降解之间存在的差异。进一步的临床前和临床研究结果表明，解读靶点耗竭时必须同时考虑通路抑制、组织暴露和耐受性。该分析确定了可用于区分相互竞争的解释、并指导调整候选分子化学结构、结构假设、预测模型或实验条件的测量指标。预测性能取决于化学和生物学背景，因此验证需要反映目标应用中所遇到的化合物、靶点和终点。当有相关组织和通路测量数据支持时，暴露-反应模型有助于解释药理学发现。此外，本文还将临床结局与个别候选分子中涉及 AI 的证据加以区分。目前的证据支持计算与实验之间的若干特定联系。需要开展前瞻性比较，以确定协调运用这些方法是否能改善候选分子的选择和药理学结局。

abstract: [Expert opinion on drug metabolism & toxicology] This study compared product information, drug-drug interaction (DDI) checkers, and artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools in detecting potential DDIs and classifying severity. In this retrospective agreement study, 100 frequently prescribed drug pairs were evaluated using Agenzia Italiana del Farmaco (AIFA) Summary of Product Characteristics, Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Prescribing Information, Micromedex, Drugs.com, ChatGPT, and OpenEvidence. Gwet's AC1 and AC2 assessed agreement in DDI detection and severity classification, respectively. Fifty-six drug pairs were identified as interacting by at least one source and 8 by all six. Micromedex reported the fewest interactions (N. =17) and ChatGPT the most (N. =49). Overall agreement for DDI detection was moderate (AC1 0.57, 95% CI 0.46-0.69); pairwise agreement ranged from fair to good. Among sources providing severity categories, overall agreement was poor (AC2 0.13, 95% CI 0.06-0.20), with pairwise AC2 estimates ranging from -0.35 (Micromedex-OpenEvidence) to 0.24 (ChatGPT-OpenEvidence). ChatGPT and OpenEvidence outputs were consistent across five trials for 59 and 84 drug pairs, respectively. DDI detection showed fair to moderate agreement across sources, while severity classification was highly inconsistent. AI-based tools may assist interpretation, but variability limits interchangeability with established resources.

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Transposable elements (TEs) are major components of eukaryotic genomes and play important roles in genome evolution and regulation, yet their accurate classification remains difficult because TE categories are hierarchically organized and many sequences are highly redundant or homologous. This redundancy can inflate reported performance if closely related elements are shared across data partitions, making reliable generalization assessment a central challenge in TE classification. To address these challenges, we propose BERTE, a hierarchical TE classification framework designed for robust prediction under similarity-controlled evaluation. BERTE combines multi-scale contextual sequence representations with protein-domain evidence and performs taxonomy-consistent prediction through a hierarchical classifier. Using a large curated benchmark constructed from 13 public TE databases with similarity-aware clustered splitting, BERTE achieves strong performance among the evaluated TE-specific, general-purpose sequence-modeling, machine-learning, and homology-based methods across hierarchical and level-specific metrics and demonstrates strong generalization on multiple independent test datasets. Overall, BERTE establishes a robust and generalizable framework for hierarchical TE classification, providing a principled solution for accurate and reliable TE classification in large-scale genomic studies.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 转座元件（TEs）是真核生物基因组的主要组成部分，在基因组进化和调控中发挥重要作用，然而其准确分类仍然困难，因为TE类别呈层级组织，且许多序列高度冗余或同源。如果相近的元件在不同数据划分之间共享，这种冗余可能会夸大所报告的性能，使可靠的泛化能力评估成为TE分类的核心挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了BERTE，这是一种层级式TE分类框架，旨在相似性受控的评估条件下实现稳健预测。BERTE将多尺度上下文序列表征与蛋白结构域证据相结合，并通过层级分类器进行符合分类体系一致性的预测。我们利用由13个公共TE数据库构建的大型人工整理基准数据集，并采用考虑相似性的聚类划分，结果显示，在所评估的TE专用方法、通用序列建模方法、机器学习方法和基于同源性的方法中，BERTE在层级指标和各层级特异性指标上均取得了较强的性能，并在多个独立测试数据集上表现出较强的泛化能力。总体而言，BERTE建立了一个稳健且可泛化的层级式TE分类框架，为大规模基因组研究中准确、可靠的TE分类提供了原则性的解决方案。

abstract: [Structure (London, England : 1993)] Volume electron microscopy (vEM) provides 3D nanoscale imaging of biological ultrastructure but faces a key limitation: anisotropic resolution, where the axial detail is markedly inferior to the lateral detail. Existing deep learning solutions lack stability, compromise structural continuity, and fail to address practical slice defects. We present IsoVEM, a robust deep learning method for high-fidelity isotropic vEM reconstruction. Utilizing a video Transformer architecture, IsoVEM captures long-range cross-slice dependencies to maintain structural continuity and delivers accurate reconstructions under significant anisotropy. This helps overcome a major bottleneck in large-scale, high-throughput ultrastructural analysis. As a self-supervised model, IsoVEM requires no pre-existing isotropic training data and generalizes well, outperforming state-of-the-art techniques across four vEM modalities. In a landmark application, IsoVEM successfully resolves the complete 3D ultrastructure of mouse sperm in seminiferous tubules, yielding unprecedented insights into organelle assembly and maturation.
zh_abstract: [Structure (London, England : 1993)] 体积电子显微镜（vEM）可对生物超微结构进行三维纳米级成像，但面临一个关键局限：分辨率各向异性，即轴向细节明显差于横向细节。现有深度学习方案缺乏稳定性，会损害结构连续性，且无法解决实际存在的切片缺陷。我们提出IsoVEM，一种用于高保真各向同性vEM重建的稳健深度学习方法。IsoVEM采用视频Transformer架构，捕捉跨切片的长程依赖以保持结构连续性，并在显著各向异性的条件下实现准确重建。这有助于克服大规模、高通量超微结构分析中的一大瓶颈。作为一种自监督模型，IsoVEM无需已有的各向同性训练数据，泛化能力良好，在四种vEM模态上均优于最先进的技术。在一项标志性应用中，IsoVEM成功解析了生精小管中小鼠精子的完整三维超微结构，为细胞器的组装和成熟提供了前所未有的见解。

title: Beyond Pose Control: Anatomically Consistent Ultrasound Video Generation

abstract: Camera-controlled video generation anticipates how a scene appears from new viewpoints by relying on a prior learned implicitly from large-scale data. Ultrasound poses the same problem, with the probe pose as the viewpoint, but under opposite conditions: anatomy offers an explicit prior that every sonographer relies on, whereas tracked scans are too scarce to learn it implicitly. As a result, pose control alone is not enough, and pose-conditioned ultrasound generators produce implausible anatomy in unscanned regions and inconsistent anatomy on revisits. We go beyond pose control and give the generator the two kinds of knowledge that make up a sonographer's mental model. An anatomical prior, built from a population of subjects, guides generation where nothing has been scanned, and is refined online by every generated chunk towards the scanned subject. A 3D latent memory, designed around the cross-sectional physics of ultrasound, compounds the generated slices into a volume of the patient and reslices it at new poses, keeping revisited anatomy consistent. The fine-grained memory enters the generator at the input, while the coarse anatomy prior guides the layout across transformer blocks. Experiments on thyroid, kidney, and lumbar spine show improved visual fidelity, pose following, and anatomical consistency over pose-conditioned and memory-augmented baselines.
zh_abstract: 相机控制的视频生成依靠从大规模数据中隐式学得的先验，来预测场景从新视角看起来的样子。超声面临同样的问题，探头位姿即视角，但条件相反：解剖学提供了每位超声医师都依赖的显式先验，而带跟踪的扫描数据过于稀缺，无法隐式学习该先验。因此，仅有位姿控制并不够，以位姿为条件的超声生成器会在未扫描区域产生不合理的解剖结构，并在重访时产生不一致的解剖结构。我们超越位姿控制，赋予生成器构成超声医师心智模型的两类知识。基于受试者群体构建的解剖先验在尚未扫描的区域指导生成，并由每个生成的片段向被扫描对象在线精化。围绕超声横截面物理特性设计的 3D 潜在记忆，将生成的切片累积为患者的体数据，并在新位姿下对其重新切片，从而使重访的解剖结构保持一致。细粒度记忆在输入端进入生成器，而粗粒度解剖先验则跨 Transformer 块指导布局。在甲状腺、肾脏和腰椎上的实验显示，相较于以位姿为条件的基线和增强记忆的基线，视觉保真度、位姿跟随和解剖一致性均有提升。

title: Privileged On-Policy Distillation for Calibrated Alzheimer's Diagnosis With Missing Modalities
zh_title: 特权在线策略蒸馏：缺失模态下的校准阿尔茨海默诊断
summary: 提出GRIP方法，通过在线策略蒸馏让模型自行补全缺失模态，并由掌握诊断信息的教师打分，用于阿尔茨海默病诊断。
key_points: 模型逐模态多次采样补全缺失数据
插补教师利用诊断标签评分，诊断教师提供软目标
预印本，摘要未给出具体性能数据

abstract: Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence, but few patients undergo every test. Because these modalities are complementary, a missing one has many plausible values. Most existing methods leave it out or train on one estimate, so their classifier never sees its other values, and the estimate is never checked against the diagnosis. We address both gaps with on-policy distillation: the model fills in the missing modalities itself, and teachers with information available only in training grade these fills. Our method, Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers, draws several fills, one modality at a time. An imputation teacher that knows the diagnosis grades each step, bringing the outcome into the imputation as statistical practice recommends. A diagnosis teacher that sees all real modalities supplies a soft target. Trained on fills that vary, the model learns a confidence that reflects what the missing tests leave open, and it diagnoses from a single rollout. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. On two external cohorts, it remains competitive in discrimination and, even after every method is recalibrated, its calibration error is level with the lowest on both. Added to three of these baselines, the teachers improve each of them. Our method offers a single, well-calibrated model for whatever combination of tests a patient has received.

title: GRLV: Gradient reversal layer with variance loss for major depressive disorder detection.
zh_title: GRLV：用于重度抑郁症检测的梯度反转加方差损失
summary: 提出可嵌入现有模型的 GRLV 框架，缓解 MEG 信号个体异质性，并在 10 个骨干模型上评估抑郁症分类。
key_points: 梯度反转层加方差损失
即插即用，测试 10 种骨干模型
针对 MEG 小样本个体异质性

abstract: [Journal of neural engineering] Deep learning models have been widely applied to predict major depressive disorder (MDD) using magnetoencephalography (MEG) signals. However, these models often suffer from limited performance and generalization. This is primarily due to the strong individual heterogeneity inherent in MEG temporal signals, which makes it difficult for models trained on small samples to distinguish disease-related features and individual-specific features. To address this issue, we propose GRLV, a plug-and-play framework based on gradient reversal layer with variance loss, that can be readily embedded into existing deep learning classification models. This framework introduces a variance loss function to the gradient reversal layer (GRL) framework to compensate for its convergence limitations. We evaluated GRLV on 10 backbone models, achieving an average classification accuracy of 68.2%, and surpassing baseline models by 3.5%. Visualization results prove that the GRLV framework effectively attends to bilateral occipital activities within the first 100 ms post stimulus on-set, which is associated with the early processing of negative emotional faces in MDD patients, and is a better disease marker due to less contamination from individual heterogeneity. These findings fully demonstrate the broad application potential of GRLV in existing MEG/EEG decoding models and the discovery of mental diseases. These findings fully demonstrate the broad applicability of GRLV on existing MEG/EEG decoding models and its potential for advancing the discovery of biomarkers of mental disorders.
zh_abstract: [神经工程杂志] 深度学习模型已被广泛应用于利用脑磁图（MEG）信号预测重度抑郁症（MDD）。然而，这些模型往往性能有限、泛化能力不足。这主要是由于MEG时间信号固有的个体异质性很强，使得在小样本上训练的模型难以区分与疾病相关的特征和个体特异性特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GRLV，一种基于梯度反转层并结合方差损失的即插即用框架，可方便地嵌入现有的深度学习分类模型。该框架在梯度反转层（GRL）框架中引入方差损失函数，以弥补其收敛方面的局限。我们在10个骨干模型上评估了GRLV，平均分类准确率为68.2%，比基线模型高出3.5%。可视化结果证明，GRLV框架能够有效关注刺激呈现后最初100 ms内双侧枕叶的活动，这与MDD患者对负性情绪面孔的早期加工相关，并且由于受个体异质性的污染较少，是更好的疾病标志物。这些发现充分证明了GRLV在现有MEG/EEG解码模型中的广泛应用潜力，以及其在发现精神疾病方面的价值。这些发现充分证明了GRLV在现有MEG/EEG解码模型上的广泛适用性，及其在推进精神障碍生物标志物发现方面的潜力。

title: JHealthBench-L: Clinician-Reviewed Localization of HealthBench for Rubric-Based Medical LLM Evaluation in Japan
zh_title: JHealthBench-L：日本本地化的医学LLM评估基准
summary: 将HealthBench经临床医师审核本地化为日本版，含79个咨询场景、1022条评分标准，用于量规式医学大模型评估（预印本）。
key_points: 79个咨询、1,022条标准
专科医师仅从零重写4.4%标准
独立审核者无异议通过93.6%的第二阶段标准
reason: 新基准但规模小、预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Rubric-based benchmarks such as HealthBench evaluate large language models (LLMs) on open-ended health consultations using case-specific physician criteria, many of which presuppose the healthcare institutions, medications, and care pathways of their source region. Under machine translation alone, these regional assumptions remain in the rubric, leaving responses appropriate in Japan uncredited or falsely penalized under foreign clinical rules. To adapt established clinical evaluation perspectives to Japan without authoring rubrics from scratch, we construct JHealthBench-L (79 patient-facing consultations, 1,022 criteria) through source-cited LLM drafting, single-specialist selection and revision, independent dual-physician review, and meta-review. Specialists rewrote only 4.4% of criteria from scratch, and independent reviewers approved 93.6% of Stage-2 criteria without issue. Comparing JHealthBench-L with a machine-translated baseline across 18 LLMs reveals that translation-only evaluation preserves coarse model rankings ($τ= 0.817$, mean shift +0.027) yet flips verdicts on 17.7% of modified criteria (vs. 7.3% re-grading noise) and reduces false penalties on Japan-adapted negative criteria by 7.1 percentage points, masking item-level clinical mismeasurement behind stable leaderboards. Axis-level and paired analyses further show that context awareness and Japan-specific clinical criteria remain primary bottlenecks, whereas Japanese continual pretraining and reasoning post-training substantially improve locally grounded performance. Datasets, physician revision logs, and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L.
zh_abstract: HealthBench 等基于评分细则（rubric）的基准，利用针对具体病例的医师标准，在开放式健康咨询上评估大语言模型（LLM），其中许多标准预设了其来源地区的医疗机构、药物和诊疗路径。仅进行机器翻译时，这些地区性假设仍保留在评分细则中，导致在日本合理的回答得不到认可，或因外国临床规则而被错误扣分。为在不从零编写评分细则的前提下，将已有的临床评估视角适配到日本，我们通过带来源引用的 LLM 起草、单一专科医师的筛选与修订、两名医师的独立审核以及元审核，构建了 JHealthBench-L（79 个面向患者的咨询，1,022 条标准）。专科医师仅从零重写了 4.4% 的标准，独立审核者在第 2 阶段无异议通过了 93.6% 的标准。在 18 个 LLM 上将 JHealthBench-L 与机器翻译基线进行比较发现，仅翻译的评估保留了模型的粗略排名（$τ= 0.817$，平均偏移 +0.027），但在 17.7% 被修改的标准上判定结果发生翻转（对比重复评分噪声 7.3%），并使针对日本适配的负向标准的错误扣分减少了 7.1 个百分点，从而使稳定的排行榜掩盖了条目层面的临床测量偏差。维度层面和配对分析进一步表明，情境意识和日本特有的临床标准仍是主要瓶颈，而日语持续预训练和推理后训练显著提升了本地化表现。数据集、医师修订日志和评估代码见 https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L。

title: TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
zh_title: TAT-Det：睾丸附件扭转超声检测与分割数据集
summary: 发布专家标注的睾丸附件扭转超声数据集，含1,203例患者2,600幅图像，提供检测框与分割掩码及基线基准。
key_points: 来自浙江大学附属儿童医院，单中心
阳性图像含边界框与像素级掩码
提供检测与语义分割基线基准

abstract: Background: Testicular appendage torsion (TAT) is the leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children. Yet, its diagnosis remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and the absence of standardized datasets for pediatric acute scrotal emergencies. Results: We present TAT-Det, an expert-annotated ultrasound dataset specifically designed for TAT. TAT-Det comprises 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients collected at the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. Each TAT-positive image is accompanied by lesion-level bounding boxes for detection and pixel-level segmentation masks for fine-grained delineation. Annotations were produced through a multi-stage workflow involving independent annotation by board-certified pediatric sonographers, consensus review, and refinement. Baseline benchmarks for object detection and semantic segmentation using representative deep learning models are further provided, with YOLO11m achieving the best detection performance and RWKV-UNet the best segmentation performance. Conclusions: TAT-Det addresses the lack of publicly available resources for pediatric emergency ultrasound and establishes a foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence methods for automated TAT analysis.
zh_abstract: 【背景】睾丸附件扭转（TAT）是青春期前儿童急性阴囊疼痛的首要原因。然而，由于临床表现不特异且缺乏针对小儿急性阴囊急症的标准化数据集，其诊断仍具挑战性。【结果】我们提出了 TAT-Det，一个专为 TAT 设计、由专家标注的超声数据集。TAT-Det 包含采集自浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院的 1,203 例患者的 2,600 张超声图像。每张 TAT 阳性图像均附有用于检测的病灶级边界框和用于精细勾画的像素级分割掩模。标注通过多阶段流程完成，包括由具有资质的儿科超声医师独立标注、共识审核和完善。此外还提供了使用代表性深度学习模型的目标检测和语义分割基线基准，其中 YOLO11m 取得最佳检测性能，RWKV-UNet 取得最佳分割性能。【结论】TAT-Det 弥补了小儿急诊超声缺乏公开可用资源的不足，为开发和评估 TAT 自动分析的人工智能方法奠定了基础。

title: RadOncGym: An Agent-Based Framework for Radiotherapy Dose-Mimicking Optimization
zh_title: RadOncGym：放疗剂量模仿优化的智能体框架
summary: 让LLM智能体迭代调整12个计划目标权重，并借助代理验证器降低求解成本，在60例OpenKBP头颈病例上评估。
key_points: LLM智能体调参剂量模仿优化
代理验证器提供快速反馈
评估600个患者-预测组合
reason: 新颖智能体方法，公开数据评估，证据有限的预印本
abstract: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy, providing an important intermediate representation for automated radiotherapy planning. However, an AI-predicted dose must undergo downstream optimization to produce a physically constrained treatment plan, a process that requires balancing competing planning objectives. We present RadOncGym, an agent-based framework that enables an LLM agent to iteratively tune 12 planning-objective weights for dose-mimicking optimization. To reduce iterative evaluation cost, RadOncGym incorporates a surrogate verifier that provides rapid feedback while allowing the agent to decide when to request a full planning solve within a fixed solve budget. We evaluate RadOncGym on 60 OpenKBP head-and-neck patients, each paired with 10 predictions from OpenKBP-Opt dose-prediction sets, yielding 600 patient-prediction contexts per experimental configuration. Under RadOncGym's 16-turn setting with a three-solve budget, a GPT-5.6 Sol agent reduces mean clinical-criterion violation by 0.6131 Gy and improves DVH and dose scores by 0.5986 and 0.2204 Gy relative to leaving all 12 weights fixed at 1, outperforming all evaluated non-agent weight-tuning methods under the same solve budget. It remains competitive with the 16-solve variants of these methods while requiring 75.0-77.6% less normalized runtime. RadOncGym demonstrates the potential of LLM agents as optimization planners in downstream radiotherapy plan optimization and provides a public testbed for their systematic evaluation. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/miaot-usc/RadOncGym.
zh_abstract: AI 剂量预测模型可根据患者解剖结构生成患者特异性三维剂量分布，为自动化放疗计划提供了重要的中间表示。然而，AI 预测的剂量必须经过下游优化才能生成受物理约束的治疗计划，该过程需要平衡相互竞争的计划目标。我们提出 RadOncGym，这是一个基于智能体的框架，使 LLM 智能体能够迭代调整剂量模仿优化中的 12 个计划目标权重。为降低迭代评估成本，RadOncGym 引入了一个代理验证器，可提供快速反馈，同时允许智能体在固定的求解预算内决定何时请求完整的计划求解。我们在 60 例 OpenKBP 头颈部患者上评估 RadOncGym，每例患者与来自 OpenKBP-Opt 剂量预测集的 10 个预测配对，每种实验配置共得到 600 个患者-预测情境。在 RadOncGym 的 16 轮设置且求解预算为三次的条件下，GPT-5.6 Sol 智能体相较于将全部 12 个权重固定为 1，使平均临床标准违反量降低 0.6131 Gy，DVH 评分和剂量评分分别提高 0.5986 和 0.2204 Gy，在相同求解预算下优于所有被评估的非智能体权重调整方法。其表现与这些方法的 16 次求解变体相比仍具竞争力，同时所需的归一化运行时间减少 75.0–77.6%。RadOncGym 展示了 LLM 智能体作为下游放疗计划优化中优化规划器的潜力，并为其系统评估提供了公开测试平台。代码和配置可在 https://github.com/miaot-usc/RadOncGym 获取。

title: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
zh_title: 从bulk数据预测细胞类型特异表达很难，但仍有用
summary: 预印本用闭式精度上界解释细胞类型特异表达反卷积为何比比例估计更难，并在106个(细胞类型,基因)对和非小细胞肺癌生存分析中检验其用途。
key_points: 推导逐基因线性估计的R²上限
可计算下界预测哪些细胞类型可学习
在NSCLC总生存上评估预后价值
reason: 预印本，有理论分析与预后评估，证据有限
abstract: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $π_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $μ_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. On overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer, estimation difficulty does not predict prognostic value across these targets. Yet a sparse survival model on deconvolved features, mostly CTSE, predicts survival as well as a sparse model on the bulk genes themselves, while attributing its signal to specific cell types. Some deconvolved CTSE features reveal prognostic signal not seen in the corresponding bulk gene.

title: EATS: Scaling Tool-Use Experience for Medical Reasoning Agents
zh_title: EATS：扩展医学推理智能体的工具使用经验
summary: 预印本提出经验增强的工具选择策略，用历史工具调用轨迹记忆检索来辅助医学推理智能体选择工具，记忆构建无需真值监督。
key_points: 记忆含查询、工具选择、参数与自评反馈
检索相关经验指导新查询的工具选择
