abstract: Medical reasoning agents combine large language model (LLM) reasoning with clinical workflows and specialized neural tools. However, general-purpose LLMs receive limited training exposure to domain-specific medical tools, and the uncertainty and distributional shifts of neural tool outputs make selecting tools from simple descriptions significantly more challenging than in deterministic settings such as calculators or dictionary lookups. In this paper, we propose EATS, an experience-augmented tool selection strategy that leverages accumulated tool-use trajectories to improve tool selection in medical reasoning agents. EATS constructs a memory of past interactions, including queries, tool choices, arguments, and self-evaluated feedback, and retrieves relevant experiences to guide tool selection for new queries. As memory construction does not require ground-truth supervision, EATS scales naturally with test-time experience. We evaluate EATS on tool-augmented medical reasoning tasks, including closed-ended visual question answering and free-form report generation. Experiments on four public datasets, ChestAgentBench, CheXbench, MIMIC-CXR, and SLAKE-VQA, across three multimodal LLMs, Qwen3-VL 2B, Qwen3-VL 32B, and GPT-5.5, show consistent gains in tool selection behavior and downstream medical reasoning performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Limingyuan001/EATS.

title: DDxBasis: Explaining Frozen Foundation Encoder-based Medical Classification by Exact Differential Diagnosis
zh_title: DDxBasis：以精确鉴别诊断解释冻结基础编码器的医学分类
summary: DDxBasis通过概念瓶颈与双极概念轴，将基于冻结基础编码器的医学分类器解释为鉴别诊断，并在五个医学数据集上评估。
key_points: 在冻结基础编码器上构建概念瓶颈
概念重组为表示诊断组差异的双极轴
结合典型表现与反事实编辑生成解释
reason: 新颖可解释方法，五数据集评估，但为预印本
abstract: In differential diagnosis (DDx), a clinician explains a diagnosis by the few findings that separate it from the alternatives. Medical image classifiers cannot yet explain themselves this way. Existing explanations are either faithful but spread over hundreds of concepts, or compact but leave part of each decision unexplained. We present DDxBasis, which explains a classifier on a frozen foundation encoder as a differential diagnosis in three steps. First, a concept bottleneck reads all patch tokens at every encoder layer using gated, second-order slot attention. A concept basis then regroups the concepts into two-pole axes, each a differential between groups of diagnoses. Finally, we read a differential diagnosis from each axis through the typical presentation of its poles, the pertinent findings of the case, and counterfactual edits of borderline cases. Across five medical datasets, DDxBasis is the most accurate frozen-encoder model and close to the best published domain-specific results. Because every concept adds its own evidence, its reproducible concept basis splits each decision exactly, at no cost in accuracy. Without ordered stage or concept labels, the axes recover cell lineages and rare subtypes, agree with dermatologists' structure annotations, and expose planted and real shortcuts.
zh_abstract: 在鉴别诊断（DDx）中，临床医生通过将某一诊断与其他备选诊断区分开来的少数几项发现来解释诊断。医学图像分类器目前尚无法以这种方式进行自我解释。现有解释要么忠实但分散于数百个概念，要么简洁但会使每个决策的一部分无法得到解释。我们提出DDxBasis，它将基于冻结基础编码器的分类器解释为一个分三步的鉴别诊断。第一步，概念瓶颈使用门控二阶槽注意力读取每个编码器层的所有patch token。随后，概念基将这些概念重新归组为两极轴，每条轴代表不同诊断组之间的一种鉴别。最后，我们通过各轴两极的典型表现、病例的相关重要发现以及对边界病例的反事实编辑，从每条轴读出一个鉴别诊断。在五个医学数据集上，DDxBasis是准确率最高的冻结编码器模型，并接近已发表的最佳领域特异性结果。由于每个概念都贡献各自的证据，其可复现的概念基能够精确拆分每个决策，且不损失准确率。在没有有序分期或概念标签的情况下，这些轴能够还原细胞谱系和罕见亚型，与皮肤科医生的结构标注一致，并能揭示人为植入的和真实存在的捷径。

title: Do Not Let the Prior Heal the Anomaly: Selective Anchoring for Detection from Incomplete Measurements
zh_title: 别让先验“治愈”异常：不完整测量下检测的选择性锚定
summary: 提出选择性锚定，保护可靠测量的图像成分不被生成先验改变，避免扩散或流模型重建抹除病灶，并给出AnchoredFM。
key_points: 生成先验可能在重建中抹除病灶
可作为预训练扩散与流采样器的封装
线性高斯模型下受保护系数无偏
reason: 预印本，方法有理论支撑，针对重建中病灶丢失问题
abstract: Generative priors can recover anatomical detail from incomplete medical measurements, but may erase the very lesions that imaging aims to detect, even when the measurements contain evidence of them. We introduce selective anchoring that protects reliably measured image components from prior-driven changes, while allowing expressive generative models to reconstruct unresolved structure. Acquisition uncertainty in the protected components is either added deterministically to the downstream test or carried by the ensemble through stochastic perturbations of the readings. We implement this principle as a wrapper for pretrained diffusion and flow samplers and as AnchoredFM, a fast constrained flow model. Under a linear-Gaussian measurement model, the protected coefficients are unbiased in expectation and achieve nominal interval coverage across repeated acquisitions, independently of the learned prior. Across sparse-view CT, accelerated brain MRI, and photoacoustic tomography, selective anchoring improves lesion contrast preservation and uncertainty reliability, and can reduce reconstruction error within lesions. For tumor detection in accelerated MRI, with a healthy reference estimated from the measurements alone, deterministic anchoring raises mean AUROC across eight samplers from 78.4% to 84.6% and lesion sensitivity at 0.25 false-positive marks per slice from 38.8% to 47.5%, with gains in all four predefined tumor-size groups. At thresholds frozen on healthy validation data, mean sensitivity rises from 20.2% to 44.1% (37.6% with stochastic anchoring). These findings show how expressive generative priors can reconstruct unresolved anatomy without healing away the abnormalities that the measurements support.
zh_abstract: 生成式先验可以从不完整的医学测量数据中恢复解剖细节，但可能抹除成像旨在检出的病灶本身，即使测量数据中包含这些病灶的证据。我们提出选择性锚定（selective anchoring），它保护可靠测量的图像成分不受先验驱动的改变，同时允许表达能力强的生成模型重建未解析的结构。受保护成分中的采集不确定性，或以确定性方式加入下游检验，或通过对读数的随机扰动由集成模型携带。我们将这一原则实现为预训练扩散和流采样器的封装器，以及一种快速的约束流模型AnchoredFM。在线性高斯测量模型下，受保护系数在期望意义上无偏，并在重复采集中达到名义区间覆盖率，且与所学先验无关。在稀疏视角CT、加速脑MRI和光声断层成像中，选择性锚定改善了病灶对比度保持和不确定性可靠性，并可降低病灶内的重建误差。对于加速MRI中的肿瘤检测（健康参考仅由测量数据估计），确定性锚定使八种采样器的平均AUROC从78.4%提高到84.6%，并使每切片0.25个假阳性标记时的病灶敏感性从38.8%提高到47.5%，且在预先定义的四个肿瘤大小组中均有提升。在基于健康验证数据固定的阈值下，平均敏感性从20.2%升至44.1%（随机锚定为37.6%）。这些发现表明，表达能力强的生成先验可以重建未解析的解剖结构，而不会“治愈”掉测量数据所支持的异常。

title: Auditing Identity and Timing Signals in Operational Logs
zh_title: 审计运行日志中的身份与时间信号泄漏
summary: 提出两种简单审计方法，在训练事件预测模型前衡量数据集中的身份与时间信息；在七个公开数据集中发现ICU数据前向填充会抬高身份可辨识度。
key_points: 身份审计与时间顺序审计，零假设下AUC为0.5
前向填充使身份AUC由0.916升至0.993
脓毒症预测任务中指标被虚高
reason: 揭示ICU预测评估泄漏，多数据集，预印本，值得一看档
abstract: Models that predict events from operational logs, such as sepsis in ICU records or failures in hard drives, can score well by recognizing which patient or drive a record came from, or when it was recorded, instead of predicting the event. I introduce two simple audits that measure how much of this information a dataset carries before any event-prediction model is trained, and apply them to seven public datasets in six domains. One asks whether a classifier can tell that two records came from the same unit; the other asks which of two records from the same unit came later. Under the stated nulls, both have expected AUC 0.5. In ICU data, the identity audit flags a common preprocessing step: carrying the last measurement forward raises identity AUC from 0.916 to 0.993. On a 12-hour sepsis forecasting task, carrying forward makes a model look 0.163 AUC better than raw values when a patient's hours are split between training and test, but only 0.046 better when patients are held out. The exaggeration under patient overlap also appears in a second ICU dataset with mortality as the outcome. On the sepsis task, a chronological control with complete follow-up, in which training sees only a patient's earlier, resolved hours, shows no positive mean overlap gap. Timing is a strong predictor: with complete follow-up, hour of stay and measurement counts alone, with no clinical value, score 0.761 on held-out patients, and adding the raw clinical values changes that by +0.018. Outside the ICU, 95% of drives and 75% of loans have records on both sides of a calendar cut, and the overlap gap persists under a calendar split. The audits show which features and preprocessing choices to check; the evaluation protocol decides the consequences. I release the code, a library that runs the audits on any table with a unit column and a time column, and a guide to using the audits.
zh_abstract: 根据运营日志预测事件的模型（例如 ICU 记录中的脓毒症，或硬盘的故障），可能并非因为预测了事件而得分很高，而是因为识别出了记录来自哪位患者或哪块硬盘，或记录于何时。我提出两种简单的审计方法，在训练任何事件预测模型之前，衡量数据集携带了多少此类信息，并将其应用于六个领域的七个公开数据集。其一检验分类器能否判断两条记录是否来自同一单元；其二检验来自同一单元的两条记录中哪一条更晚。在所述零假设下，两者的期望 AUC 均为 0.5。在 ICU 数据中，身份审计标出了一个常见的预处理步骤：向前填充最近一次测量值（carrying the last measurement forward）会使身份 AUC 从 0.916 升至 0.993。在一项 12 小时脓毒症预测任务中，当同一患者的各小时数据被分入训练集和测试集时，向前填充使模型看起来比使用原始值的 AUC 高 0.163；而当按患者留出时，仅高 0.046。在以死亡率为结局的第二个 ICU 数据集中，同样出现了患者重叠导致的夸大。在脓毒症任务中，采用随访完整的按时间顺序对照（训练仅见患者较早且已有结局的小时数据），未显示出正的平均重叠差距。时间信息是很强的预测因子：在随访完整的情况下，仅用住院小时数和测量次数（不含任何临床数值），在留出患者上得分为 0.761，加入原始临床数值后变化为 +0.018。在 ICU 之外，95% 的硬盘和 75% 的贷款在日历切分点两侧都有记录，且在日历切分下重叠差距依然存在。这些审计指出了应检查哪些特征和预处理选择；评估方案决定其后果。我发布了代码、一个可在任何含单元列和时间列的表格上运行这些审计的库，以及审计使用指南。

title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical Question Answering on ESC Cardiology Guidelines: Evaluation and Retrieval Optimization
zh_title: ESC心脏病指南问答中的幻觉缓解：评估与检索优化
summary: 基于160个问题和627条人工核验指南记录，逐条对照人工判断检验验证-修订流程的失败方式，并比较检索配置。
key_points: 160题数据集，经执业内科医生审核
五阶段流程，四种检索配置，1920次运行
人工审计606条首轮被驳斥的声明
reason: 规范的人工审计评估，但规模较小，预印本，值得一看档
abstract: Background: Large language models produce hallucinations in medical question answering (QA). Verify-and-revise pipelines that check atomic claims against retrieved guideline evidence are a standard mitigation, but evaluations almost universally treat the verifier's output as ground truth, an assumption rarely tested. Objective: To measure, claim by claim against human judgement, how such a pipeline fails in a guideline-grounded clinical setting. Methods: We built a dataset of 160 questions (100 patient vignettes from 89 de-identified cases, 60 fact-based) over four recent ESC cardiology guidelines, all approved by a practising internist, and a retrieval corpus of 627 hand-verified guideline records at two chunk granularities. A five-stage pipeline was run under four retrieval configurations and three independent runs (1920 arm-runs); all 606 first-pass refuted claims were manually audited, an independent judge re-judged 906 decisions, and the expert blindly reviewed 100 accepted claims. Results: Only 44.7-50.6% of flagged claims were true hallucinations. Correction loops converged in 85.2-95.1% of cases, yet 35% of genuine final errors were introduced by correction. Single-run true-hallucination recall was 35.6-41.2%, the three-run union 71-80%; verifier agreement was moderate (kappa = 0.505). The blind probe estimated the accepted-claim miss rate at 3.2% (95% CI 0.7-6.7%). Final genuine-error rate: 1.7% of answers. Conclusion: Claim-level verification reduces hallucinated content by an order of magnitude, but verifier reliability, not generation, is the limiting factor and must be measured, not assumed.
zh_abstract: 【背景】大语言模型在医学问答（QA）中会产生幻觉。将原子性声明与检索到的指南证据进行核对的“验证-修订”流程是一种标准缓解手段，但评估几乎都将验证器的输出视为真值，而这一假设很少经过检验。【目的】在以指南为依据的临床情境中，逐条声明地对照人工判断，衡量此类流程如何失败。【方法】我们基于四部近期的 ESC 心脏病学指南构建了包含 160 个问题的数据集（100 个来自 89 例去标识病例的患者情景题，60 个事实类问题），均经一名执业内科医师批准；并构建了包含 627 条人工核实的指南记录、具有两种分块粒度的检索语料库。五阶段流程在四种检索配置和三次独立运行下运行（共 1920 个配置-运行）；对全部 606 条首轮被驳斥的声明进行了人工审核，由一名独立评判者重新评判 906 项决定，并由专家对 100 条被接受的声明进行盲法复核。【结果】被标记的声明中只有 44.7-50.6% 是真正的幻觉。修正循环在 85.2-95.1% 的情况下收敛，但 35% 的真实最终错误是由修正引入的。单次运行的真实幻觉召回率为 35.6-41.2%，三次运行的并集为 71-80%；验证器之间的一致性为中等（kappa = 0.505）。盲法探查估计被接受声明的漏检率为 3.2%（95% CI 0.7-6.7%）。最终真实错误率：1.7% 的回答。【结论】声明层面的验证可使幻觉内容减少一个数量级，但限制因素是验证器的可靠性而非生成，必须对其进行测量，而不能想当然地假定。

title: EGSE: Evidence-Grounded Skill Evolution for Medical Reasoning Agents
zh_title: EGSE：医学推理智能体的证据支撑技能演化
summary: EGSE从相似病例的历史对话中提炼可复用的条件化工作流，经证据支持和验证的更新逐步完善技能库，以改进医学影像智能体。
key_points: 评估中间推理与工具使用，而非仅看答案
对比成功与失败轨迹提炼经验与规避指引
生成带适用条件的工作流
reason: 新颖的医疗智能体方法，摘要未见具体结果，预印本，值得一看档
abstract: Medical reasoning agents combine foundation models with specialized tools to interpret medical images, yet reusing their historical experience remains challenging. A correct final answer can conceal flawed reasoning or tool use, synthesized advice may lack source support, and superficially similar cases may require different diagnostic procedures. In this paper, we propose EGSE, an evidence-grounded skill evolution framework that distills historical dialogues from similar cases into reusable conditional workflows and progressively refines a multi-faceted skill library through supported and validated updates to improve medical agents. EGSE evaluates intermediate reasoning and tool use and contrasts repeated successful and failed rollouts to extract useful practices and evidence-supported avoidance guidance. These experiences are synthesized into workflows with applicability conditions and checks traceable to source dialogues. Library additions and merges require source-grounded review and execution validation. At inference time, EGSE routes queries to skill nodes organized by imaging modality, question task type, and disease category, then retrieves and selects applicable workflows based on their conditions, the current images, and the question to guide evidence acquisition and interpretation. Experiments across four chest X-ray benchmarks show that EGSE outperforms representative medical agents and skill evolution methods in reasoning accuracy while reducing tool calls. It also delivers consistent accuracy gains across seven foundation models and supports skill transfer across datasets.

title: Look at What Matters: Learning Lesion Prototypes from Severity Labels for Domain-Generalized Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
zh_title: 基于严重度标签学习病灶原型的域泛化糖网分级
summary: 仅用图像级严重度标签学习病灶与背景原型，以加性序数评分模型实现可解释、域泛化的糖尿病视网膜病变分级。
key_points: 多实例约束引导多尺度病灶/背景原型竞争学习
仅由病灶原型响应预测严重度，无全局分类通路
加入退化下教师保持与空间正则以提升证据可靠性
reason: 眼科域泛化新方法，预印本，摘要未见具体结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Deep learning models for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading often generalize poorly to unseen imaging domains, in part because predictions may exploit correlations specific to source datasets rather than retinal pathology. We address this challenge by constructing grading decisions from lesion evidence learned using only image severity labels. Clinical implications of DR grades provide multiple instance constraints that guide competitive learning of lesion and background prototypes at multiple scales. An additive ordinal scoring model then predicts severity exclusively from individual lesion prototype responses, explicitly connecting learned evidence with grading decisions without a global feature classification pathway. To improve the reliability of this evidence, we introduce teacher guided preservation under image degradations and spatial regularization against persistent coordinate preferences. Across six public DR datasets under a leave one domain out protocol, our method attains a mean quadratic weighted kappa of 0.761, outperforming the strongest competing method by 0.036. Localization and prototype removal analyses show that the learned responses align with retinal lesions and contribute to grading decisions. Experiments across five other prototype architectures and under image degradations further demonstrate the generality and robustness of the approach.

title: DoseSteer: Steering diffusion-based dose prediction models towards clinical targets via Dual-Response Guidance
zh_title: DoseSteer：以双响应引导使扩散剂量预测模型达成临床目标
summary: 提出推理时框架DoseSteer，无需重训即可引导冻结的扩散式放疗剂量预测模型满足结构级临床剂量目标。
key_points: Dual-Response Guidance联合求解各结构引导强度
覆盖三种扩散架构、三个数据集共五种配置
无需重训，推理时纠正剂量偏离
reason: 新颖推理时方法且跨多配置对比，但为预印本、无临床验证
abstract: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy. Yet these predictions can still miss structure-level clinical dose targets. Once deployed, most existing predictors offer no direct mechanism to correct such deviations, deferring target enforcement to downstream plan optimization. We introduce DoseSteer, an inference-time framework that steers frozen diffusion-based dose prediction models towards specified clinical targets without retraining. To meet clinical targets while preserving overall dose prediction quality, we propose Dual-Response Guidance (DRG), a structure-centric algorithm that probes the model's responses to perturbations in each structure's noisy dose and context and jointly solves for per-structure steering strengths. Across five dataset-model configurations spanning three diffusion architectures and three datasets, DRG outperforms 12 training-free baselines under identical reference-derived target proxies, removing at least 97% of the target error, reducing the official dose error by 7.8% on average, and improving dose fidelity outside the steered structures. DoseSteer reconciles learned anatomical dose priors with explicit structure-level targets at test time, establishing a principled, training-free mechanism to refine AI dose predictions prior to plan optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/csp2002/DoseSteer.
zh_abstract: AI 剂量预测模型可根据患者解剖结构生成患者特异性的三维剂量分布。然而，这些预测仍可能未达到结构层面的临床剂量目标。现有大多数预测器在部署后并没有直接的机制来纠正此类偏差，而是将目标的执行推迟到下游的计划优化环节。我们提出 DoseSteer，这是一种推理阶段框架，可在无需重新训练的情况下，将冻结的基于扩散模型的剂量预测模型引导至指定的临床目标。为在保持整体剂量预测质量的同时满足临床目标，我们提出双响应引导（Dual-Response Guidance，DRG），这是一种以结构为中心的算法：它探测模型对各结构的含噪剂量及其上下文扰动的响应，并联合求解各结构的引导强度。在涵盖三种扩散架构和三个数据集的五种数据集—模型配置中，在相同的由参考剂量推导的目标代理条件下，DRG 优于 12 种无需训练的基线方法，消除了至少 97% 的目标误差，使官方剂量误差平均降低 7.8%，并提高了被引导结构以外区域的剂量保真度。DoseSteer 在测试时将习得的解剖剂量先验与显式的结构层面目标相协调，建立了一种原则性的、无需训练的机制，用于在计划优化之前改进 AI 剂量预测。代码见 https://github.com/csp2002/DoseSteer。

title: Where Does Free-Text 3D Grounding Fail? An Error Analysis of Report-Sentence Segmentation in Chest CT
zh_title: 胸部CT自由文本三维定位失败原因分析
summary: 在ReXGroundingCT验证集381个发现上分析VoxTell，仅定位53.5%，失败多为预测过大、邻近病灶误定位或小病灶漏检。
key_points: VoxTell定位成功率53.5%
很少出现左右侧或病灶混淆
去除位置词后性能减半
reason: 对公开模型的误差分析，有信息量但无新方法
abstract: Free-text 3D grounding, segmenting in a CT volume the region described by one sentence of the radiology report, could link reports to images at scale, but it is unclear where current models fail. We analyse the publicly released VoxTell model on all 381 findings of the 200-scan ReXGroundingCT validation set, where it grounds 53.5% of findings. Its failures are rarely about which lesion or side is meant. No miss lies on the side opposite to the one named, and findings are almost never confused with one another. Instead, predictions are too large, land on a neighbouring lesion on the correct side, or are missing for small findings, and diffuse findings are rarely grounded. Removing location words halves performance, to the level of label-only prompting, and anatomical rules derived from the sentence never improve the full-sentence output. The same pattern holds on the hidden 300-scan test set. Further progress therefore depends on extent estimation and small-lesion sensitivity rather than on anatomical post-processing.
zh_abstract: 自由文本三维定位，即在CT容积中分割出放射学报告中一句话所描述的区域，可以实现报告与图像的大规模关联，但目前尚不清楚现有模型在何处失败。我们在ReXGroundingCT验证集的200例扫描共381个发现上分析了公开发布的VoxTell模型，该模型成功定位了53.5%的发现。其失败很少涉及所指的是哪个病灶或哪一侧。没有任何漏检位于与所述侧别相反的一侧，各发现之间也几乎不会相互混淆。相反，预测结果要么过大，要么落在正确一侧的相邻病灶上，要么对小发现缺失，而弥漫性发现很少被定位。去除位置词会使性能减半，降至仅使用标签提示的水平，而从句子中导出的解剖学规则从未改善完整句子的输出。在隐藏的300例扫描测试集上也呈现同样的模式。因此，进一步的进展取决于范围估计和小病灶敏感性，而非解剖学后处理。

title: Continuous Foundation-Guided Pseudo-Label Weighting for Breast Ultrasound Domain Adaptation
zh_title: 基础模型引导的连续伪标签加权用于乳腺超声域适应
summary: 用冻结的超声分割模型AutoSAMUS调节EMA教师伪标签权重，在五个公开乳腺超声数据集的跨域分割上做无监督域适应评估。
key_points: 每个目标像素以[0.5,1]权重监督
测试时无需基础模型推理
覆盖三个源域、十一个源-目标方向
reason: 多公开数据集对比的新方法预印本，增量改进
abstract: Breast ultrasound segmentation models often generalize poorly across scanners, institutions, and patient populations. We investigate continuous foundation-guided pseudo-label weighting for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher generates target-domain pseudo-labels, while a frozen ultrasound segmentation model (AutoSAMUS) modulates their contribution using a bounded weight that combines the prior's certainty with its probabilistic agreement with the teacher. In contrast to our earlier selective BiRP rule, the proposed formulation supervises every target pixel with a weight in [0.5, 1] and requires no foundation-model inference at test time. We evaluate the method on five public breast ultrasound datasets, spanning three source domains and eleven source-target directions. Under the TransUNet protocol, continuous weighting outperforms both all-pixel EMA and original BiRP on all four BUSI-source targets, and achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest HD95 among the compared methods on all four BUS-BRA-source targets. Results with BrEaST as the source are mixed: continuous weighting performs best on BUSI and comparably to original BiRP on OASBUD, whereas none of the adaptation methods surpasses source-only training on BUS-UCLM. In a separate U-Net pipeline, agreement-only weighting performs comparably to the full formulation, leaving the incremental value of prior certainty unresolved. Because the weighting rule was developed after some target-test results had been examined, we treat the study as exploratory and report adverse as well as favorable outcomes.

abstract: Reconstructing 3D joint kinematics from a single video is ill-posed due to depth and stature ambiguity, limb occlusion, and missing uncertainty estimates. We introduce the Biomechanical Flow Model (BFM), a continuous-time flow-matching prior over subject anthropometry, anatomical joint-angle trajectories, and virtual markers, trained on multi-camera clinical recordings from 565 participants and steered toward monocular 2D keypoints at test time without paired video training. In a head-to-head comparison on the same clinical trials against a state-of-the-art deterministic trajectory optimizer fitting the identical skeleton, BFM achieves comparable joint-angle accuracy across walking and timed-up-and-go (TUG). Across held-out control, prosthetic, and neurologic participants, BFM reaches 3.91 deg and 4.97 deg mean absolute joint-angle error on walking and TUG while providing credible intervals that bridge temporal and whole-limb occlusions. Where keypoints are hidden, the intervals widen with the error and keep their coverage near nominal. Supplying individual anthropometric calibration removes most monocular pelvis depth error, whereas testing on out-of-distribution pediatric crouch gait produces biased, overconfident extension predictions, highlighting the need for pathologically diverse movement priors.

abstract: [JCO clinical cancer informatics] Transitions of care from hospital to outpatient settings represent a vulnerable period for patients with cancer, who often face complex treatment regimens, multiple comorbidities, and fragmented coordination across care settings. These challenges contribute to communication breakdowns and unplanned hospital readmissions. Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and digital health technologies offer new opportunities to improve the transitional phases before, during, and after hospital discharge, and strengthen care continuity. This review examines emerging approaches enabled by AI and digital health across the inpatient-to-outpatient care spectrum for hospitalized patients with cancer. We discuss how predictive analytics and clinical decision support can identify patients at elevated risk of complications and guide discharge planning before hospitalization ends. We also review existing AI and digital health solutions tailored to the discharge process, including tools that enhance patient and caregiver education, medication reconciliation, follow-up coordination, discharge documentation, and management of pending test results. Finally, we explore post-discharge technologies, such as remote monitoring, symptom tracking systems, and AI-assisted communication platforms, that empower earlier detection of clinical deterioration and facilitate integration with outpatient and community-based resources. Overall, we highlight, as well as describe the limitations of, innovations that seek to improve coordination, reduce administrative burden, and support safer, more proactive transitions of care for patients undergoing cancer treatment.

abstract: [JACC. Cardiovascular imaging] Aortic stenosis is characterized by progressive fibrocalcific remodeling driven by inflammation, fibrosis, and calcification. abstract: [Current oncology (Toronto, Ont.)] Multidisciplinary tumor boards (MDTs) guide prostate cancer decisions but are strained by rising case volumes, evolving guidelines, and growing complexity. Artificial intelligence (AI) now enters the MDT at two levels. First, it generates inputs: deep-learning magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reading matches or exceeds radiologists' performance in the Prostate Imaging-Cancer Artificial Intelligence (PI-CAI) study; Gleason grading reaches expert-level agreement; PSMA PET quantification is automated; and multimodal pathology biomarkers predict ADT benefit. Second, decision-support systems act on MDT output: rule-based tools reproduce standard recommendations in 86-99% of cases, mostly in populations dominated by standard cases, whereas general-purpose large language models (LLMs) agree with real urological boards in 56-93% of cases, depending largely on input quality and case mix, and perform worse in metastatic disease; agreement does not establish clinical benefit. Of 33 appraised decision-support studies, 27 were at high risk of bias, 20 of them solely because the treating board served as an unblinded reference standard; explainability, regulation, and automation bias remain unresolved. We propose that AI currently serves as a supervised pre-reader, guideline checker, and triage tool. Prospective multicenter studies with patient outcomes are needed.

abstract: [Frontiers in molecular biosciences] G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) regulate complex pathophysiological networks and represent a critical class of drug targets, but their structural determination and ligand screening are constrained by dependence on homology templates, static conformations, and a bias toward known ligands. Artificial intelligence is fundamentally transforming GPCR structural biology and pharmacology by overcoming these bottlenecks. The methodologies encompass high-precision static structure prediction, dynamic conformational ensemble modeling, ultra-large-scale virtual screening, de novo ligand design, allosteric mechanism decoding, biased signaling quantification, and systems pharmacology. Deep learning architectures enable end-to-end structure prediction exemplified by AlphaFold series, billion-compound virtual screening and unbiased de novo ligand design via diffusion models. Three-dimensional structure-aware Graph neural networks and molecular dynamics simulations are shifting research focus from single static conformations to transient conformations, cryptic allosteric sites, and ligand-induced biased signaling. Systems-level investigation through multi-omics-integrated GPCR digital twins advances personalized precision medicine. This review summarizes the innovative AI-driven paradigm, breaking traditional restrictions and greatly improving structural resolution of orphan receptors and GPCR complexes, thereby offering a comprehensive reference for dynamic GPCR pharmacological research. Core challenges include the black-box nature of deep learning, structural distribution biases, and the translational gap, which can be addressed by physics-informed models and high-throughput validation.

abstract: Large language models can apply a written rubric to a transcript, making automated coding of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2) look within reach. A common way to align such a rater with clinicians is to show it expert-scored examples, but whether correct labels improve agreement is rarely tested. We test this for eight speech-based items of hour-long ADOS-2 Module 3 sessions from 48 children, with one local model and a pre-registered, placebo-controlled design. We compare few-shot scoring, an anchored comparison in which the model only judges a child better, similar or worse than scored anchors and a fixed rule gives the score, post-hoc calibration, protocol-based evidence routing and direct scoring of the full transcript. On 40 held-out children, agreement with clinicians was modest, with quadratic weighted kappa between 0.22 and 0.30. Replacing every example's label with a wrong one changed about a third of the few-shot predictions, more often towards the corrupted labels than chance, but did not lower agreement, 0.25 with correct and 0.23 with wrong labels. A larger second model did the same. The anchored comparison did not improve on few-shot scoring, its cross-child judgements were no more accurate than those implied by absolute scores, and routing did not help. Among the registered, uncalibrated arms, direct scoring of the full transcript agreed best at 0.30. Exploratory follow-up analyses found that the model's graded judgements ranked children better than its final scores, that existing batch calibration raised agreement to 0.46 on the same children, and that in controlled synthetic sessions scoring episodes separately did not beat calibrated whole-transcript scoring. Expert-scored examples do not by themselves calibrate model-based clinical raters, and claims of calibration or added pipeline complexity need corrupted-label controls and strong baselines.

title: GASTON-VI efficiently quantifies spatial axes and molecular gradients from multi-sample, multi-modal spatial-omics data

abstract: Many tissues exhibit an underlying spatial axis along which fundamental biological processes occur due to continuous spatial gradients of cell type and molecular state. Modern spatial-omics technologies measure molecular features (e.g. gene/protein expression) at 100,000s-1,000,000s of locations within a two-dimensional (2-D) tissue slice, with large-scale atlases profiling multiple tissue slices of the same organ type across different individuals and biological conditions (e.g. healthy versus diseased). However, existing computational methods for identifying spatial molecular gradients are limited to small spatial transcriptomics datasets (1000s of cells) of a single tissue slice, while methods for integrating multiple samples do not explicitly model spatial axes nor spatial molecular gradients along such axes. Here, we present GASTON-VI, a variational inference (VI)-based deep learning model which efficiently learns an underlying spatial axis and spatial molecular gradients along this axis from multi-sample, multi-condition spatial-omics data of any molecular modality (e.g. transcriptomics, proteomics). GASTON-VI jointly learns (1) a spatial coordinate (the "isodepth") for each individual tissue slice and (2) 1-D spatial modality functions that describe molecular gradients along the isodepth for tissues of the same biological condition, while utilizing a latent variable model to account for batch effects. Further, GASTON-VI implements a statistical test for identifying molecules with differential spatial gradients across biological conditions (e.g. healthy versus diseased). On spatial transcriptomics and proteomics data from the intestine, tonsil, and liver, we show that GASTON-VI recovers spatial axes and molecular gradients along these axes more accurately and efficiently than existing methods. In particular, applied to large-scale spatial transcriptomics and proteomics atlases, GASTON-VI reveals differential spatial gradients of gene expression along the portal vein-central vein axis in fibrotic livers, and differential spatial gradients of protein abundance along the muscularis-lumen axis across different regions of the intestine. Software availability: GASTON-VI is available at https://github.com/chitra-lab/GASTON-VI.
zh_abstract: 许多组织呈现出一条潜在的空间轴，由于细胞类型和分子状态的连续空间梯度，基本生物学过程沿该轴发生。现代空间组学技术可在二维（2-D）组织切片内数十万至上百万个位置测量分子特征（如基因/蛋白表达），大规模图谱则对不同个体和不同生物学条件（如健康与疾病）下同一器官类型的多个组织切片进行分析。然而，现有用于识别空间分子梯度的计算方法仅限于单个组织切片的小型空间转录组数据集（数千个细胞），而整合多个样本的方法既未显式建模空间轴，也未对沿该轴的空间分子梯度进行建模。在此，我们提出 GASTON-VI，这是一种基于变分推断（VI）的深度学习模型，可从任意分子模态（如转录组、蛋白质组）的多样本、多条件空间组学数据中高效学习潜在的空间轴及沿该轴的空间分子梯度。GASTON-VI 联合学习：（1）每个组织切片的空间坐标（“isodepth”）；（2）描述同一生物学条件下组织中沿 isodepth 的分子梯度的一维空间模态函数，同时利用潜变量模型处理批次效应。此外，GASTON-VI 实现了一种统计检验，用于识别在不同生物学条件（如健康与疾病）之间具有差异空间梯度的分子。在来自肠、扁桃体和肝脏的空间转录组和蛋白质组数据上，我们显示 GASTON-VI 比现有方法更准确、更高效地恢复空间轴及沿这些轴的分子梯度。具体而言，应用于大规模空间转录组和蛋白质组图谱时，GASTON-VI 揭示了纤维化肝脏中沿门静脉-中央静脉轴的基因表达差异空间梯度，以及肠道不同区域沿肌层-管腔轴的蛋白丰度差异空间梯度。软件可用性：GASTON-VI 可在 https://github.com/chitra-lab/GASTON-VI 获取。

abstract: Characterizing the cellular composition of the tumor microenvironment from histological images is fundamental to understanding cancer biology and informing treatment decisions. Deep learning has enabled automated nuclear detection and classification from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images, yet cell classifiers remain largely confined to broad morphological categories owing to a reliance on manual annotations. Recent efforts have used spatial molecular measurements to supervise histological classification, but these approaches often require separate tissue sections or produce altered H&E staining, and the resulting cell-type annotations depend on subjective choices such as marker selection and clustering parameters. Here we develop XenoType, a framework that classifies cells into seven molecularly informed categories directly from routine histology, trained using paired same-section Xenium spatial transcriptomics. Cell-type annotations are reconciled from four single-cell RNA-sequencing references, reducing dependence on marker choices. Across eight held-out breast tissue sections, XenoType outperformed commonly used CellViT++ retrained on the same molecular annotations under both four-class (macro-F1: 0.703 vs. 0.569) and seven-class (macro-F1: 0.571 vs. 0.403) taxonomies, with the largest gains for myoepithelial (F1: 0.175 to 0.572) and endothelial cells (F1: 0.395 to 0.682). Molecular measurements are required only during training; at inference, XenoType uses the H&E image alone. Model-reference agreement increased consistently with annotation confidence, and XenoType generalized to an independently profiled breast tissue section from a different spatial transcriptomics platform, supporting scalable cell-type mapping from routine histology without per-specimen molecular profiling.

abstract: [Journal of imaging] Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) route predictions through a layer of human-understandable concepts, but classical CBMs need a concept label for every training image, a cost that is high in medicine. Vision-language models (VLMs) remove that requirement because, in a shared image-text embedding space, a large language model can propose candidate concepts and contrastive similarity can score them, with no concept labels. This review surveys annotation-free VLM-based CBMs and their move into clinical imaging. We cover vision-language foundations (CLIP, ALIGN, LLaVA) and trace concept models from early supervised methods (CBM, CEM, TCAV) to versions that work without manual labels (LaBo, Label-Free CBM, PCBM, OpenCBM, VLG-CBM). We then map these foundations to specific medical fields such as radiology, pathology, cardiology, dermatology, and ophthalmology, highlighting the medical VLM-CBMs closest to actual deployment (CBVLM, AdaCBM, ConcepPath, CBM-RAG). We focus on information leakage, in which task information reaches the prediction through the concept layer without being carried by the named concepts. Two of the seven surveyed medical VLM-CBMs test whether their predictions depend on individual concepts, but none measures leakage, and no shared protocol exists. We identify this gap as a central challenge for interpretable medical AI.

abstract: Understanding how genomic information gives rise to bacterial phenotypes is a fundamental problem in biology. Genome-level prediction requires models that integrate information from thousands of proteins, while related phenotypes may share genomic signals. However, not all phenotype tasks benefit from being learned together, and suitable task groups can be difficult to define from biological knowledge alone. We present VenusPheno, a framework that combines multiple-instance learning over pretrained ProtT5 protein embeddings with transfer-guided multi-task learning. An attention-based Set Transformer aggregates the proteins in each genome into a genome-level representation. We evaluate VenusPheno on 14 binary phenotype tasks from 12,178 bacterial genomes using genus-disjoint splits. Under single-task training, VenusPheno outperforms computational, conventional machine-learning, and deep-learning baselines in terms of mean balanced accuracy. We then use leave-one-task-out analysis to estimate directed transfer relationship between phenotypes, revealing both beneficial and detrimental interactions. Grouping tasks based on these transfer relationships further improves mean balanced accuracy over independent training and joint training of all tasks. Although inferred without biological priors, the resulting groups are consistent with biologically plausible relationships among phenotypes. VenusPheno therefore combines accurate phenotype prediction with a data-driven strategy for determining which tasks should be learned together. The PyTorch implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/YJinling/VenusPheno.
zh_abstract: 理解基因组信息如何产生细菌表型是生物学中的一个基本问题。基因组水平的预测需要整合来自数千个蛋白质信息的模型，而相关表型可能共享基因组信号。然而，并非所有表型任务都能从联合学习中获益，仅凭生物学知识也难以界定合适的任务分组。我们提出 VenusPheno，该框架将基于预训练 ProtT5 蛋白质嵌入的多实例学习与迁移引导的多任务学习相结合。基于注意力的 Set Transformer 将每个基因组中的蛋白质聚合为基因组水平表示。我们在来自 12,178 个细菌基因组的 14 个二分类表型任务上，采用属不相交的数据划分评估 VenusPheno。在单任务训练下，VenusPheno 在平均平衡准确率方面优于计算方法、传统机器学习和深度学习基线。随后，我们采用留一任务法分析来估计表型之间的有向迁移关系，揭示了有益和有害的相互作用。基于这些迁移关系对任务进行分组，相较于独立训练和所有任务联合训练，进一步提高了平均平衡准确率。尽管推断过程未使用生物学先验，所得分组与表型之间生物学上合理的关系相一致。因此，VenusPheno 将准确的表型预测与一种数据驱动的、用于确定哪些任务应一起学习的策略相结合。PyTorch 实现已公开，网址为 https://github.com/YJinling/VenusPheno。

title: Data drift in clinical imaging AI: Medicolegal liability after deployment.

abstract: [Clinical imaging] Data drift refers to changes in the distribution or characteristics of input data after deployment that may adversely affect the performance of artificial intelligence (AI) systems, even when the software continues to function exactly as designed. Patient demographics, disease prevalence, referral patterns, imaging protocols and technology continue to evolve after deployment, resulting in a divergence between the data distribution a model was trained on and the distribution it encounters in practice, without any discrete coding error or malfunction. These technical realities raise distinctive medicolegal questions when a patient is harmed by a degraded model. Establishing negligence centers on whether an ongoing institutional duty exists to monitor for performance deterioration, how breach can be proved absent consensus benchmarks for surveillance frequency and how causation can be demonstrated where AI output is only one element of clinical decision-making and its reasoning may be an opaque "black box" to its users. Comparative fault principles may allocate responsibility according to relative control and knowledge among institutions, vendors and radiologists. Products liability exposure and federal preemption laws also play a role. Risk reduction measures include lifecycle documentation, risk proportionate surveillance, auditability of algorithms and outputs, contractual allocation of monitoring responsibility, and sustained clinician oversight. Radiologists and institutions should anticipate a standard of care that evolves well before controlling case law develops.
zh_abstract: [Clinical imaging] 数据漂移是指部署后输入数据的分布或特征发生变化，即使软件仍完全按设计运行，也可能对人工智能（AI）系统的性能产生不利影响。患者人口学特征、疾病患病率、转诊模式、影像检查方案和技术在部署后持续演变，导致模型训练所用的数据分布与其在实际中遇到的分布之间出现偏离，而这并不涉及任何明确的编码错误或故障。当患者因性能下降的模型而受到伤害时，这些技术现实引发了独特的医疗法律问题。认定过失的核心在于：是否存在持续监测性能退化的机构义务；在缺乏关于监测频率的共识基准的情况下如何证明违反该义务；以及当 AI 输出只是临床决策的一个环节、且其推理对使用者而言可能是不透明的“黑箱”时，如何证明因果关系。比较过错原则可依据机构、供应商和放射科医师之间相对的控制力和知情程度来分配责任。产品责任风险和联邦优先适用法律也发挥作用。降低风险的措施包括全生命周期文档记录、与风险相称的监测、算法及输出的可审计性、监测责任的合同分配，以及持续的临床医师监督。放射科医师和相关机构应预见到，注意标准的演变将远早于具有控制力的判例法形成之前。

abstract: [Journal of the American Dental Association (1939)] Precision oral health requires clinicians to consider patient-specific clinical, biological, behavioral, imaging, and preference sensitive data when making clinical decisions. In routine oral health care, however, these data are often fragmented across electronic dental records, imaging platforms, diagnostic tests, narrative notes, and patient-generated sources. Clinical decision support (CDS) systems provide a mechanism for organizing these data and translating them into timely, evidence-informed recommendations at the point of care. A narrative review was conducted of peer-reviewed literature relevant to precision dentistry, CDS, dental informatics, artificial intelligence, biomarkers and omics technologies, and patient-generated health data. Priority was given to dental studies, which were supplemented by broader medical CDS literature when dental-specific evidence was limited. CDS systems can function as digital infrastructure and generate clinical recommendations based on patient-specific data using evidence-based knowledge and predictive analytics. In dentistry, CDS applications range from rule-based reminders and electronic quality measures to artificial intelligence-assisted radiographic interpretation, risk prediction, biomarker screening, and emerging multimodal platforms. The clinical readiness of these technologies varies substantially, and their value depends on data quality, validation, work flow integration, usability, interoperability, privacy safeguards, and clinician oversight. CDS systems can assist clinicians by offering evidence-based, personalized recommendations that synthesize pertinent and available information. These systems are crucial for practicing precision dentistry. Although efforts to enhance the adoption, usability, effectiveness, and acceptance of CDS systems continue, clinicians should always regard CDS systems as tools and retain full responsibility for their decisions and involve patients in the decision-making process.

abstract: [Facial plastic surgery : FPS] Aims and Backgrounds: Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly expanding applications in diagnosis, surgical planning, and postoperative care. This state-of-the-art review characterizes the growth and use of AI across perioperative care with particular attention to microvascular and free flap reconstruction, and examines how this growth compares with the pace of clinical validation. Techniques: PubMed (MEDLINE), Scopus, and Web of Science were searched through August 10, 2026 for studies evaluating AI in facial plastic surgery, oral and maxillofacial surgery, microvascular head and neck surgery, and facial reanimation. Pediatric-only, non-English, and non-AI-focused studies were excluded. Conclusions and Clinical Relevance: Of 1,249 articles, 66 met inclusion criteria. Preoperative applications accounted for 50% of studies, focusing on surgical planning, image segmentation, and risk stratification. Postoperative applications accounted for 45%, including free flap monitoring and outcome assessment. Intraoperative applications represented 6%. Deep learning and convolutional neural networks were the most common approaches, while few studies included prospective evaluation. AI use has grown rapidly in facial plastic and reconstructive surgery, with uses in preoperative planning, risk prediction, and postoperative free flap monitoring. Despite growth, clinical validation and prospective evaluation remain limited, particularly for intraoperative applications. Research focused on prospective application of technology will determine how AI can be safely incorporated into facial reconstructive surgery.

abstract: ComBat harmonizes multicentre radiomic features, but batch variables are usually chosen manually, without a standardized criterion across image acquisition parameters. We propose ParsiComBat, which selects acquisition parameters for ComBat, balancing batch-effect removal against feature-structure preservation and abstaining when technical variation is negligible. ParsiComBat ranks candidate acquisition parameters by batch effect, filters redundancy, and scores sequential ComBat corrections. We evaluated it in three experiments: in simulations, testing whether it recovered a known batch variable and abstained without one; in CT (NSCLC-Radiomics) and MRI (MAMA-MIA) cohorts, comparing batch-effect removal against manufacturer (manual), every feasible parameter (greedy) and AutoCombat; and in clinical prediction, internally and externally. In simulations, ParsiComBat identified the true batch variable in 92.9% of positive trials and abstained in 99.2% of null controls. In CT, correcting for reconstruction kernel reduced mean k-nearest neighbour batch-effect test from 0.276 to 0.032, almost matching greedy correction of six variables. In MRI, correcting for slice thickness and manufacturer reduced it from 0.680 to 0.325, slightly more than manual selection but less than greedy correction of seven variables. Removing technical variation did not improve clinical discrimination: no strategy, including raw features, differed significantly from ParsiComBat in area under the curve. ParsiComBat provides a data-driven framework that removes technical batch effects using minimal acquisition parameters, preserving feature structure and clinical discrimination. It selects variables verifiable against the acquisition protocol and abstains when no correction is needed, supporting transparent, reproducible multicentre radiomics.
zh_abstract: ComBat可用于协调多中心影像组学特征，但批次变量通常由人工选择，在图像采集参数方面缺乏统一的标准。我们提出ParsiComBat，该方法为ComBat选择采集参数，在去除批次效应与保留特征结构之间取得平衡，并在技术变异可忽略时选择不进行校正。ParsiComBat按批次效应对候选采集参数排序，过滤冗余，并对依次进行的ComBat校正进行评分。我们通过三项实验对其进行了评估：在模拟实验中，检验其能否识别已知的批次变量，以及在没有批次变量时是否会放弃校正；在CT（NSCLC-Radiomics）和MRI（MAMA-MIA）队列中，将批次效应去除效果与按制造商校正（人工）、对每个可行参数校正（贪婪）以及AutoCombat进行比较；以及在内部和外部的临床预测中。在模拟实验中，ParsiComBat在92.9%的阳性试验中识别出真实的批次变量，在99.2%的空白对照中放弃校正。在CT中，校正重建核使平均k近邻批次效应检验值从0.276降至0.032，几乎与对六个变量进行贪婪校正的结果相当。在MRI中，校正层厚和制造商使该值从0.680降至0.325，略优于人工选择，但不及对七个变量进行贪婪校正。去除技术变异并未改善临床判别能力：包括原始特征在内，没有任何策略在曲线下面积上与ParsiComBat存在显著差异。ParsiComBat提供了一个数据驱动的框架，仅使用最少的采集参数即可去除技术性批次效应，同时保留特征结构和临床判别能力。它选择可对照采集方案核实的变量，并在无需校正时放弃校正，从而支持透明、可重复的多中心影像组学研究。

abstract: [Canadian family physician Medecin de famille canadien] To provide family physicians with a practical overview of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in primary care practice and their potential to address burnout, improve workflow, support clinical decision making, and enhance patient care. A comprehensive narrative review of AI tools in primary care was conducted using peer-reviewed literature from PubMed, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar, with subject headings artificial intelligence and primary care, along with related terms. Relevant real-world pilot projects and case studies were hand-searched to identify those not captured through database searches. Canadian family physicians are facing rising levels of burnout, driven by overwhelming administrative demands and increasing patient complexity. With 1 in 4 Ontarians estimated to be without a family doctor in 2026, primary care is under considerable strain. AI tools-particularly those powered by natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs)-offer timely, practical solutions across 4 domains: ambient AI scribes to reduce documentation time and enhance patient-physician interaction; intelligent document processing and clinical summarization to streamline inbox management and information retrieval; clinical evidence synthesis LLMs to summarize medical evidence at the point of care; and AI clinical decision support systems to improve diagnosis and disease management. Real-world implementation in primary care demonstrates these tools can improve workflow efficiency, reduce time spent on paperwork, enhance adherence to clinical guidelines, and improve patient satisfaction. However, inaccuracies in AI-generated content, model bias, lack of transparency, and data privacy risks all require careful oversight. AI and NLP applications have potential to be timely tools that reduce strain and restore capacity for relational, person-centred care. Thoughtful adoption-guided by evidence-informed deployment, user-centred design, and regulatory safeguards-will be essential to ensure safe, equitable integration into primary care practice.

abstract: [Talanta] Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) is a systems-level thermodynamic tool for probing disease-related changes in complex biological fluids, yet clinical translation is hindered by challenges in thermogram interpretation, reproducibility, and data integration. DSC captures heat capacity transitions from multistate protein unfolding, reflecting collective stability landscapes of the plasma proteome. Pathological conditions can induce reproducible thermogram distortions, suggesting their utility as ensemble biomarkers beyond conventional scalar descriptors. Recent advances in ultrasensitive and microfluidic DSC have improved stability and reduced sample needs, while artificial intelligence enables extraction of distributed calorimetric features beyond melting temperature and enthalpy. Machine learning strategies-including statistical, kernel-based, deep learning, and physics-informed frameworks-help identify informative thermodynamic patterns. This review integrates thermodynamic principles, data-driven analytics, and clinical studies to assess DSC's capabilities and limitations. We further propose practical standardization and minimum-reporting frameworks for DSC acquisition, preprocessing, AI model development, and validation to improve reproducibility and cross-study comparability. Persistent issues such as inter-laboratory variability, cohort heterogeneity, small datasets, and regulatory hurdles continue to restrict routine use. Overall, combining DSC with AI offers a promising analytical framework for extracting clinically meaningful thermodynamic insights and advancing disease characterization.
zh_abstract: [Talanta] 差示扫描量热法（DSC）是一种用于探测复杂生物体液中疾病相关变化的系统层面热力学工具，但其临床转化受到热谱图解读、可重复性和数据整合等方面挑战的阻碍。DSC 捕获多态蛋白质解折叠的热容转变，反映血浆蛋白质组的集体稳定性图景。病理状态可诱导可重复的热谱图畸变，提示其可作为超越传统标量描述符的整体性生物标志物。超灵敏和微流控 DSC 的最新进展提高了稳定性并减少了样品需求，而人工智能则能够提取除熔解温度和焓之外的分布式量热特征。机器学习策略——包括统计方法、基于核的方法、深度学习以及物理信息框架——有助于识别具有信息量的热力学模式。本综述整合热力学原理、数据驱动分析和临床研究，以评估 DSC 的能力与局限。我们进一步提出了针对 DSC 采集、预处理、AI 模型开发和验证的实用标准化及最低报告框架，以提高可重复性和跨研究可比性。实验室间变异、队列异质性、数据集规模小以及监管障碍等持续存在的问题，仍在限制其常规应用。总体而言，将 DSC 与 AI 相结合提供了一个有前景的分析框架，可用于提取具有临床意义的热力学见解并推进疾病表征。

abstract: Simulating clinical time series necessitates temporal realism, calibration that preserves model integrity, and privacy transparency. We present a train-only, constrained language-model pipeline that factorizes generation. A compact GPT-style language model learns cross-biomarker co-occurrence through quantile tokens, and temporal directions are enforced by 3x3 per-biomarker Markov transitions fit on TRAIN, allowing dynamics to be audited. We fit a monotone quantile map (QMap) on TRAIN only (SYN(TRAIN) -> SIM(TRAIN)); no TEST statistics are used. The fixed map is then applied to SYN(TEST) severities. The constrained LM demonstrated improved distributional fidelity and co-occurrence in a 5,000-patient simulated testbed (parameters within published clinical ranges) compared to an empirical sampler, maintained near-chance detectability after a small lambda-sweep, and exhibits temporal adherence by construction. A classifier-based membership-inference audit results in an AUC of approximately 0.5; we make no differential-privacy claim. We present multi-seed results with paired 95% confidence intervals and quantify the severity of QMap's alignment (Delta W1 with confidence interval). This is a Stage-1 method result obtained on a controlled simulator; Stage-2 validation on real EHR cohorts with clinical endpoints is planned.

abstract: Medical image classifiers in clinical practice must continually evolve to accommodate emerging disease categories while maintaining reliable classification of existing conditions. This is challenging because privacy and data-sharing restrictions limit access to historical patient data, while assigning dedicated capacity to each new diagnostic task causes linear model growth. Effective evolution requires preserving prior disease knowledge without retaining historical images while expanding model capacity only when necessary. To this end, we propose PICE, a Prototype-Informed Conditional Model Evolution framework organized around what to preserve, when evolution is needed, and how that evolution is realized. PICE preserves prior disease knowledge in a prototype-statistical memory. For each incoming task, it assesses compatibility with historical references reconstructed from memory, reusing the closest adapter when compatibility is sufficient and instantiating a new one when evolution is required. PICE then realizes evolution by updating the memory and recalibrating the unified classifier with Gaussian pseudo features, thereby integrating new knowledge into the cumulative diagnostic space. During inference, memory-derived similarities guide task-agnostic adapter selection and fusion, enabling prediction over all learned disease categories. Experiments on Skin8, Kvasir-V2, and Path16 demonstrate the effectiveness of PICE across diverse clinical scenarios. On Skin8, PICE achieves a 7.60\% improvement in accuracy over the SOTA method on new tasks, while maintaining 71.10\% accuracy on previous tasks. It also reduces additional learnable parameters by 18.51\%. These results indicate that PICE improves classification while balancing knowledge retention, adaptation, and parameter growth, supporting continual model evolution as new diagnostic categories emerge without access to historical images.

abstract: Deep learning models for prostate MRI segmentation often struggle to generalize when trained on limited heterogeneous data, leading to boundary errors and over-segmentation. We present an augmentation framework using mask-conditioned synthetic and diverse T2-weighted MRI volumes to improve boundary precision and reduce over-segmentation. We employ a 2.5D weakly mask-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) via channel concatenation. The diffusion model conditions on stacks of adjacent binary masks from training folds. The model generates T2 volumes consistent with the conditioning anatomy while diversifying tissue appearance. We evaluate the proposed approach on two cohorts of data: (i) the LUND probe cohort (n=432) for strategy selection and training nnU-Net from scratch with a 23% synthetic data mix, and (ii) the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) prostate cohort (n=32) evaluated with a 20% synthetic data mix. For the LUND cohort, we found that training an nnU-Net model from scratch with a 23% synthetic data mix reduced the mean false-positive voxels per case from 11,102 (baseline) to 10,757. On the MSD cohort, the augmented model with a 20% synthetic mix achieved a mean cross-validated Dice of 0.9094, improving over the baseline (0.8935) by 1.59 percentage points and reducing mean false-positive voxels by 23.1% (4,201 to 3,229). Experimental results on both these cohorts suggest that mask-conditioned DDPM augmentation can reduce over-segmentation errors and improve boundary adherence in data-constrained settings.
zh_abstract: 在有限且异质的数据上训练的前列腺MRI分割深度学习模型往往泛化能力不足，导致边界误差和过度分割。我们提出一种增强框架，利用以掩膜为条件的合成且多样化的T2加权MRI体数据，以提高边界精度并减少过度分割。我们采用一种通过通道拼接实现的2.5D弱掩膜条件去噪扩散概率模型（denoising diffusion probabilistic model，DDPM）。该扩散模型以来自训练折的相邻二值掩膜堆叠为条件，生成与条件解剖结构一致、同时使组织外观多样化的T2体数据。我们在两个数据队列上评估所提方法：(i) LUND probe队列（n=432），用于策略选择，并以23%的合成数据混合比例从头训练nnU-Net；(ii) Medical Segmentation Decathlon（MSD）前列腺队列（n=32），采用20%的合成数据混合比例进行评估。在LUND队列中，我们发现以23%合成数据混合比例从头训练nnU-Net模型，可将每例平均假阳性体素数从11,102（基线）降至10,757。在MSD队列中，采用20%合成混合比例的增强模型取得平均交叉验证Dice为0.9094，较基线（0.8935）提高1.59个百分点，并使平均假阳性体素数减少23.1%（从4,201降至3,229）。在这两个队列上的实验结果表明，在数据受限的情形下，以掩膜为条件的DDPM增强可以减少过度分割错误并改善边界贴合度。

abstract: Post-stroke aphasia is clinically heterogeneous, and conventional classifications may not capture differences in brain functional organisation. We tested whether resting-state and task-based functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) could identify neurophysiological subgroups alongside clinical assessment.Seventy-nine patients underwent unsupervised clustering using three fNIRS feature views: resting-state activity and connectivity, language-task activation, and rest-to-task connectivity reconfiguration. Similarity network fusion and spectral clustering integrated the views. Clinical and behavioural measures were excluded from clustering.Three clusters (n = 32, 17 and 30) were identified. This solution had the largest eigengap and was the only candidate significant after permutation testing and Holm correction (adjusted P = 0.001). It was stable under subsampling (mean adjusted Rand index, 0.773), but agreement fell to 0.217 when the resting-state view was removed. Clusters differed in most regional intrinsic-activity measures and all resting-state connectivity summaries, with few differences in task activation or connectivity reconfiguration. Their profiles showed higher right anterior prefrontal activity, distributed fronto-sensorimotor and parietal alterations, and reduced interhemispheric connectivity, respectively.Cluster membership was not significantly associated with conventional aphasia subtype (Cramér's V = 0.287), and baseline clinical language scores and task performance did not differ between clusters.These findings identify three neurophysiological subgroups distinguished mainly by intrinsic activity and resting-state functional connectivity, not clearly aligned with conventional aphasia classifications or baseline clinical measures. Multi-view fNIRS analysis may complement clinical characterisation, requiring independent and longitudinal validation.
zh_abstract: 卒中后失语症在临床上具有异质性，传统分类可能无法反映脑功能组织的差异。我们检验了静息态和任务态功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）能否结合临床评估识别神经生理亚组。79例患者基于三种fNIRS特征视角接受了无监督聚类：静息态活动与连接性、语言任务激活，以及从静息到任务的连接性重构。采用相似性网络融合（similarity network fusion）和谱聚类整合各视角。临床和行为指标未纳入聚类。共识别出三个聚类（n = 32、17和30）。该解具有最大的特征间隙（eigengap），并且是唯一在置换检验和Holm校正后仍显著的候选解（校正后P = 0.001）。该解在子采样下稳定（平均调整兰德指数为0.773），但去除静息态视角后一致性降至0.217。各聚类在大多数区域内在活动指标和所有静息态连接性汇总指标上存在差异，而在任务激活或连接性重构方面差异较少。它们的特征分别表现为：右侧前额叶前部活动较高、额-感觉运动区和顶叶区域分布性改变，以及半球间连接性降低。聚类归属与传统失语症亚型无显著关联（Cramér's V = 0.287），各聚类间的基线临床语言评分和任务表现也无差异。这些发现识别出三个主要由内在活动和静息态功能连接性区分的神经生理亚组，其与传统失语症分类或基线临床指标并无明显对应关系。多视角fNIRS分析可能对临床特征评估起补充作用，但仍需独立及纵向验证。

title: Structure-Aware Multimodal Retrieval Under Data Scarcity, Privacy Constraints and Out-of-Domain Content
zh_title: 数据稀缺与隐私约束下的结构感知多模态检索
summary: 提出基于版面几何与本地8B视觉语言模型的图注配对检索流程，在法医病理等三个私有语料上评估，几何配对正确率达77%–96%。
key_points: 无需标签、数据不出本地
三个私有语料，10,421幅图
reason: 私有小语料，应用面窄，增量档
abstract: Purpose: Figure retrieval from reference atlases in expert domains like forensic pathology, dentistry and geology must work without labels or training pairs, on content that often cannot leave local hardware, and on images outside the training data of image-text encoders. This work proposes a structure-aware pipeline that satisfies all three, retrieving figures through the page structure recovered by layout geometry and a local open-weight 8B VLM. Methods: A geometry-based pairing method is introduced, in which the model receives a schematic of the detected boxes and selects each picture's caption without access to pixels or text. Caption retrieval is evaluated on three private corpora (29 books, 10,421 figures, 218 queries) with blind human grading, against a lexical baseline, generated descriptions and five image-text encoders. Results: Geometric pairing was correct for 96%, 92% and 77% of pictures in the three domains, against 76%, 45% and 53% for the better of two document parsers. A hosted model given the schematic was equally accurate, while coordinates as text lost 22 points. Caption retrieval obtained an nDCG@5 of 0.85, 0.87 and 0.76, against 0.54, 0.51 and 0.27 for the best cross-modal encoder and 0.41, 0.28 and 0.30 for generated descriptions. Pairing errors carried over to retrieval. Conclusion: The proposed pipeline achieves accurate figure retrieval with small local models and no in-domain training, where general and biomedical image-text encoders fall far behind. Its geometry-only pairing is the most accurate of five methods and exposes no content, even to a hosted model. Code and prompts are released.
zh_abstract: 【目的】在法医病理学、牙科学和地质学等专业领域，参考图谱中的图像检索必须在无标签、无训练配对的情况下进行，所处理的内容往往不能离开本地硬件，且图像超出了图文编码器的训练数据范围。本研究提出一种满足上述三项要求的结构感知流程，通过版面几何以及本地开放权重的 8B 视觉语言模型（VLM）恢复的页面结构来检索图像。【方法】提出一种基于几何的配对方法：模型接收检测到的各边界框的示意图，并在无法获取像素或文本的情况下为每幅图片选择其图注。在三个私有语料库（29 本书、10,421 幅图、218 条查询）上，通过盲法人工评分评估图注检索，对照词汇基线、生成的描述以及五种图文编码器。【结果】在三个领域中，几何配对对图片的正确率分别为 96%、92% 和 77%，而两种文档解析器中较优者分别为 76%、45% 和 53%。获得该示意图的托管模型准确率相当，而将坐标作为文本输入则损失 22 个百分点。图注检索的 nDCG@5 分别为 0.85、0.87 和 0.76，而最佳跨模态编码器分别为 0.54、0.51 和 0.27，生成描述分别为 0.41、0.28 和 0.30。配对错误会延续到检索中。【结论】所提出的流程使用小型本地模型且无需领域内训练即可实现准确的图像检索，而通用及生物医学图文编码器则远远落后。其仅基于几何的配对是五种方法中最准确的，且即使对托管模型也不暴露任何内容。代码和提示词已公开。

title: BreathSplat: Grounding One Smooth Motion in the Breathing Phase for 4D Cone-Beam CT
zh_title: BreathSplat：基于呼吸相位的4D锥束CT高斯重建
summary: 用B样条动态高斯表示4D体积，并把运动锚定在呼吸相位，使不同呼吸周期同相位投影共同约束同一解剖，在模拟肺部扫描上评估。
key_points: 动态高斯+时空B样条运动
由常规替代信号读取呼吸相位
仅在模拟肺扫描上验证
reason: 新方法但仅模拟数据验证，增量档
abstract: Four-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (4D-CBCT) images the anatomy of a breathing patient, but sees each breathing phase from only a few angles. Breathing, however, is a smooth motion that repeats; it has a phase. Existing methods exploit this either by reconstructing the anatomy as a function of the breathing phase, often through bins, or by estimating smooth dynamic motions in time. Yet none of these grounds one smooth motion in the phase. We thus propose to share projections across breathing phases with splines. Specifically, we represent the 4D volume with dynamic Gaussians whose motion uses B-splines in space and time. We ground the motion state in the respiratory phase, which we read from well-studied conventional surrogates. Projections at the same phase in different breathing cycles then constrain the same anatomy and motion. On simulated lung scans, our method, BreathSplat, outperforms recent dynamic methods in reconstruction and motion accuracy, including those given the ground-truth phase. We further show qualitatively, on two real patient scans, that our method provides clearer reconstructions than the state of the art.
zh_abstract: 四维锥形束计算机断层扫描（4D-CBCT）可对呼吸中患者的解剖结构成像，但每个呼吸相位仅能从少数角度观测。然而，呼吸是一种平滑且重复的运动，具有相位。现有方法利用这一点的方式，要么是（常通过分箱）将解剖结构重建为呼吸相位的函数，要么是在时间上估计平滑的动态运动。但这些方法都没有将单一的平滑运动建立在相位之上。因此，我们提出用样条在不同呼吸相位之间共享投影。具体而言，我们用动态高斯表示 4D 体数据，其运动在空间和时间上采用 B 样条。我们将运动状态建立在呼吸相位上，该相位由成熟的常规替代信号读取。这样，不同呼吸周期中相同相位的投影就约束了相同的解剖结构与运动。在模拟肺部扫描上，我们的方法 BreathSplat 在重建和运动精度方面优于近期的动态方法，包括那些获得真实相位的方法。我们还在两例真实患者扫描上定性地表明，我们的方法比现有最先进方法提供更清晰的重建。

title: Structured Noise Diffusion for Echocardiography Haze Removal
zh_title: 面向超声心动图雾状伪影去除的结构化噪声扩散模型
summary: 提出结构感知扩散框架，将超声雾状伪影建模为受扇形几何约束的局部高斯成分累积，用于超声心动图去雾恢复。
key_points: 以局部高斯成分建模空间相关的雾状伪影
前向过程按超声扇形几何采样噪声
双头网络预测锚点概率图与尺度参数
reason: 新颖方法预印本，摘要未见外部验证或临床效果
abstract: Echocardiographic images are frequently degraded by spatially structured haze artifacts that obscure anatomical boundaries and hinder clinical analysis. Conventional diffusion models typically employ pixel-independent Gaussian noise, limiting their ability to represent localized ultrasound haze. In this study, we propose a structure-informed diffusion framework that explicitly models ultrasound haze as an accumulation of localized Gaussian components constrained by the ultrasound fan geometry. The forward process generates spatially correlated corruption by sampling component locations and scales, providing a formulation that better reflects the spatial characteristics of real echo artifacts. During reverse restoration, a dual-head network predicts an anchor probability map and Gaussian scale parameters to progressively remove structured artifacts while reducing the center bias associated with direct coordinate regression. We evaluated the framework on the public DehazingEcho2025 benchmark and two private clinical datasets, without retraining or fine-tuning on either private cohort. Our method achieved the highest mean generalized contrast-to-noise ratio across all three datasets, reaching $0.715 \pm 0.090$ on the public benchmark while preserving tissue edges.
zh_abstract: 超声心动图图像常受空间结构化雾状伪影（haze artifacts）影响，这类伪影会遮蔽解剖边界并妨碍临床分析。传统扩散模型通常采用像素独立的高斯噪声，限制了其表示局部性超声雾状伪影的能力。本研究提出一种结构信息引导的扩散框架，将超声雾状伪影显式建模为受超声扇形几何约束的局部高斯分量的累积。前向过程通过对分量位置和尺度进行采样来生成空间相关的退化，该表述能更好地反映真实超声心动图伪影的空间特征。在反向复原过程中，双头网络预测锚点概率图和高斯尺度参数，以逐步去除结构化伪影，同时减轻直接坐标回归所带来的中心偏置。我们在公开的 DehazingEcho2025 基准和两个私有临床数据集上评估该框架，且未在任一私有队列上进行再训练或微调。我们的方法在三个数据集上均取得最高的平均广义对比噪声比（generalized contrast-to-noise ratio），在公开基准上达到 $0.715 \pm 0.090$，同时保留了组织边缘。

title: EPPC-CARE: Staged Hierarchical Annotation of Communication Behaviors in Secure Patient-Provider Messages
zh_title: EPPC-CARE：患者门户消息中沟通行为的分阶段层级标注
summary: 提出 EPPC-CARE 框架，用开源大模型从患者-医护门户消息中识别沟通行为及其支撑文本，并与 EPPC-OASIS、监督微调及人工标注对比。
key_points: 基于 867 条消息、5,516 条参考标注（片段-类别-子类别三元组）
评估六个开源权重大模型
在 100 条消息上与人类专家标注比较
reason: 单一数据集、样本规模有限的预印本，临床 NLP 增量方法
abstract: Objectives: Patient portal messages provide invaluable information about communication dynamics between patients and healthcare providers, but extracting it manually is labor-intensive. We developed and evaluated EPPC-CARE, an automated framework for identifying communication behaviors together with the supporting text for each classification. Materials and Methods: From 867 messages, we obtained 5,516 reference standard annotations. Each annotation is a triplet of communication-related text (span), a broader communication category (Code), and a specific subcategory (Sub-code). We evaluated EPPC-CARE's identified triplets across six open-weight large language models (LLMs) against supervised fine-tuning and communication-based models such as EPPC-OASIS. We also compared EPPC-CARE with human expert annotations on 100 messages. Results: EPPC-CARE improved performance over EPPC-OASIS across all six models. EPPC-CARE's Triplet F1 improved by 2.90 percentage points on average, with a best score of 64.4%. On the human expert evaluation subset, EPPC-CARE and the human expert showed comparable agreement with the reference standard, with differences favoring EPPC-CARE. Discussion: These findings suggest that identifying triplet components (span, code, subcode) sequentially can improve performance across model families while preserving the supporting text behind each identification. EPPC-CARE links the communication code and subcode with the source text (span), supporting human verification of automated annotations in clinical informatics. EPPC-CARE may therefore make larger-scale studies of patient-provider communication more feasible and provide a foundation for human-in-the-loop annotation workflows. Conclusion: EPPC-CARE offers a more reliable and reviewable approach for automated characterization of communication behaviors in secure patient-provider messaging.
zh_abstract:
【目的】患者门户消息为了解患者与医疗服务提供者之间的沟通动态提供了极为宝贵的信息，但人工提取这些信息耗费大量人力。我们开发并评估了 EPPC-CARE，这是一个自动化框架，用于识别沟通行为，并为每一项分类提供相应的支持文本。
【材料与方法】我们从 867 条消息中获得了 5,516 条参考标准标注。每条标注为一个三元组，包括与沟通相关的文本（span）、较宽泛的沟通类别（Code）以及具体的子类别（Sub-code）。我们在六个开放权重大语言模型（LLM）上评估了 EPPC-CARE 所识别的三元组，并与监督微调模型及基于沟通的模型（如 EPPC-OASIS）进行比较。我们还在 100 条消息上将 EPPC-CARE 与人类专家标注进行了比较。
【结果】在所有六个模型上，EPPC-CARE 的性能均优于 EPPC-OASIS。EPPC-CARE 的三元组 F1 平均提高了 2.90 个百分点，最佳得分为 64.4%。在人类专家评估子集上，EPPC-CARE 与人类专家同参考标准的一致性相当，差异略偏向 EPPC-CARE。
【讨论】这些结果表明，按顺序识别三元组的各个组成部分（span、code、subcode）可以提升不同模型家族的性能，同时保留每项识别背后的支持文本。EPPC-CARE 将沟通的 code 和 subcode 与来源文本（span）相关联，有助于在临床信息学中对自动化标注进行人工核验。因此，EPPC-CARE 可能使更大规模的患者—医疗服务提供者沟通研究更为可行，并为人机协同（human-in-the-loop）标注工作流程奠定基础。
【结论】EPPC-CARE 为在安全的患者—医疗服务提供者消息传递中自动刻画沟通行为提供了一种更可靠、更便于复核的方法。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Early Diagnosis and APOE-Targeted Therapeutics of Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review.
source: PubMed · Current topics in medicinal chemistry

summary: 系统综述检索多个数据库，介绍阿尔茨海默病的诊断与治疗，涉及AI与医学影像等手段。

abstract: [Current topics in medicinal chemistry] Forty to fifty percent of patients have at least one copy of the APOE4 gene mutation, which is the major genetic risk factor for late-onset alzheimer's disease. Risk is increased three to seven times by carrying one copy (heterozygous) and up to twelve to fifteen times by carrying two copies (homozygous). This cognitive decline is linked to impairments in perception, vocabulary, social interaction, and visuospatial performance, as well as alterations in executive function, which affect the capacity to carry out daily tasks. The purpose of this study is to provide comprehensive information on the diagnosis and treatment of Alzheimer's disease. Various search engines like Pub Med, Scopus, Google Scholar, Web of Science, and Elsevier databasesare searched. Progressive loss of memory is the most common symptom of the disease. Advanced medical imaging technologies offer important insights into human anatomy and function. Compounds with mechanisms of action and clinical trials are also incorporated. This also compiles literature on nanocarriers for improved bioavailability. Altogether, 194 studies are included. Amyloid-β plaques are pathologically seeded within the nervous system by APOE, with APOE4 promoting earlier and more prevalent amyloid deposition. Furthermore, by identifying alterations in the brain, Convolutional Neural Networks, a type of deep learning and machine learning technology, have shown an elevated level of precision in diagnosing AD. The Present manuscript has promising therapeutic outcomes, integrating extensive evidence on phytocompounds, nanoparticle-based approaches, and clinical trials. It also highlights key diagnostic parameters and emphasizes the potential of these therapeutic strategies to improve treatment efficacy while minimizing systemic adverse effects.
zh_abstract: [Current topics in medicinal chemistry] 40%至50%的患者至少携带一个APOE4基因突变拷贝，该突变是晚发型阿尔茨海默病的主要遗传危险因素。携带一个拷贝（杂合子）可使风险增加三至七倍，携带两个拷贝（纯合子）可使风险增加高达十二至十五倍。这种认知衰退与感知、词汇、社交互动和视空间能力的损害以及执行功能的改变有关，进而影响完成日常任务的能力。本研究旨在提供有关阿尔茨海默病诊断和治疗的全面信息。检索了PubMed、Scopus、Google Scholar、Web of Science和Elsevier等数据库。进行性记忆丧失是该病最常见的症状。先进的医学影像技术为了解人体解剖和功能提供了重要信息。文中还纳入了具有作用机制的化合物及临床试验，并汇总了关于提高生物利用度的纳米载体的文献。总计纳入194项研究。APOE在神经系统内可促使淀粉样蛋白-β斑块在病理上形成，其中APOE4促进更早、更广泛的淀粉样蛋白沉积。此外，卷积神经网络（一种深度学习和机器学习技术）通过识别脑部改变，在诊断AD方面已显示出较高的精确度。本文展现出有前景的治疗结果，整合了关于植物化合物、基于纳米颗粒的方法及临床试验的大量证据。文章还强调了关键的诊断参数，并强调这些治疗策略在提高治疗效果的同时减少全身不良反应的潜力。

title: An Alert Is Not a Referral: Toward Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning in Gastric Cancer Screening.
source: PubMed · Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology

summary: 通讯文章指出可穿戴传感器检测到的步态扰动不等于真正的近跌倒事件，提出结合传感器与LLM提取叙述信息的情境化多模态框架。

abstract: [Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology] Accurate identification of near-fall events is essential for early fall-risk assessment and prevention in older adults. However, translating laboratory-trained machine learning algorithms into real-world settings remains challenging because abnormal gait patterns do not necessarily represent genuine near-fall events. This correspondence highlights the distinction between sensor-detected gait perturbations and clinically meaningful losses of balance, emphasizing the limitations of conventional signal-based classification and the absence of event-level validation. We propose a context-grounded multimodal framework integrating wearable sensor data with large language model-derived information from patient narratives, caregiver reports, and clinical documentation. Such integration could support contextual event interpretation, distinguish habitual gait instability from transient balance disturbances, and facilitate clinically adjudicated near-fall identification. We further emphasize the importance of prospective validation, uncertainty-aware prediction, subgroup fairness, and clinically relevant performance metrics. Advancing from isolated movement classification toward context-aware, clinically validated event detection may improve individualized fall-risk prediction and support more effective preventive interventions in geriatric care.

abstract: [Recent patents on nanotechnology] Drug research, formulation development, manufacturing, quality control, and pharmacovigilance are just a few areas of the pharmaceutical industry that have undergone a paradigm shift with the introduction of artificial intelligence (AI). The numerous ways that AI-driven technologies impact each stage of the pharmaceutical life cycle are examined in this comprehensive analysis. One subfield of machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) that stands out is deep learning (DL), which uses artificial neural networks (ANNs) to find intricate patterns and relationships in massive datasets by simulating the structure of the human brain. These methods have produced state-of-the-art results in fields such as speech detection, natural language understanding, image recognition, pharmacophore selection, and protein targeting. The manuscript discusses how data analytics, machine learning algorithms, and predictive modelling can be used to improve Pharmaceutical formulation development throughout its life cycle. This critical review provides important insights into the changing dynamics of drug development through AI-driven innovation by outlining the latest developments and patents.

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to influenza prevention and control. AI encompasses conventional machine learning, deep learning, and protein language models. Large language models (LLMs) are an emerging subset of AI. Current evidence remains weakly linked to real-world workflows and population health outcomes. This structured narrative review proposes a three-stage translational maturity framework. Phase I is technical efficacy assessment. Phase II is implementation effectiveness verification. Phase III is population impact and sustainability. We synthesized evidence in three domains: viral evolution prediction and vaccine design; epidemic surveillance and early warning; and individual-level infection risk detection and clinical monitoring. We used a three-level evidence hierarchy. Level A is influenza-specific evidence. Level B is transferable evidence from other infectious diseases. Level C is general biomedical or methodological evidence. Only two Phase II studies were identified, both in epidemic surveillance and early warning; no Phase II studies were identified in virus evolution and vaccine design or in individual-level infection risk detection. No study met the prespecified Phase III criteria. Phase III requires demonstrated downstream population health benefit. Prospective deployment or improved forecasting alone is not sufficient. Across domains, bottlenecks have shifted from model accuracy to governance, interpretability, accountability, interoperability, workflow integration, equity, and sustainable monitoring. LLMs attract major attention, but their influenza-specific evidence remains limited. Their greatest value may lie in augmenting, not replacing, specialized models and human expertise. We propose phase-specific evidence thresholds, implementation-oriented evaluation metrics, an implementation readiness checklist, and priority evidence gaps for translating AI-enabled influenza tools into implementation-ready public health applications.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 人工智能（AI）在流感防控中的应用日益增多。AI 包括传统机器学习、深度学习和蛋白质语言模型。大语言模型（LLM）是 AI 中新兴的一个子集。目前的证据与真实世界工作流程及人群健康结局之间的联系仍然较弱。本结构化叙述性综述提出了一个三阶段转化成熟度框架：第一阶段为技术效能评估；第二阶段为实施有效性验证；第三阶段为人群影响与可持续性。我们在三个领域综合了证据：病毒进化预测与疫苗设计；疫情监测与早期预警；以及个体层面的感染风险检测与临床监测。我们采用三级证据层次：A 级为流感特异性证据；B 级为来自其他传染病的可迁移证据；C 级为一般生物医学或方法学证据。仅发现两项第二阶段研究，均属于疫情监测与早期预警领域；在病毒进化与疫苗设计领域以及个体层面感染风险检测领域均未发现第二阶段研究。没有研究符合预先设定的第三阶段标准。第三阶段要求证明下游人群健康获益；仅有前瞻性部署或预测改进并不足够。在各领域中，瓶颈已从模型准确性转向治理、可解释性、问责、互操作性、工作流程整合、公平性以及可持续的监测。LLM 备受关注，但其流感特异性证据仍然有限。其最大价值可能在于增强而非取代专业模型和人类专业知识。我们提出了分阶段的证据阈值、面向实施的评价指标、实施就绪度核查清单以及优先证据缺口，以推动将基于 AI 的流感工具转化为可实施的公共卫生应用。

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] A growing consensus in the imaging community holds that radiomics has been rendered obsolete by foundation models and end-to-end deep learning. We disagree, and this perspective explains why. The critics are partially right: inter-operator segmentation variability has compromised reproducibility, methodological quality has been inconsistent, and the gap between published AUCs and clinical implementation has been wide. However, they draw the wrong conclusion. In renal cell carcinoma (RCC), where preoperative contrast-enhanced CT is already standard of care for every patient undergoing nephrectomy and where approximately 30% will recur after surgery, radiomics remain an immediately actionable, interpretable, and deployable non-invasive prognostic tool available. We argue that its primary technical limitation (segmentation variability) is being eliminated by the same deep learning technology used to argue against it: automated segmentation frameworks such as nnU-Net achieve Dice coefficients exceeding 0.93 on external cohorts, removing inter-operator noise. We further argue that in low-prevalence, high-stakes oncological settings, the data volumes required to pre-train foundation models do not exist, and that interpretability - now a regulatory requirement under the EU AI Act for high-risk clinical AI systems - is native to handcrafted radiomics and must be retrofitted onto deep learning architectures. Most critically, we present biological evidence that CT images encode tumor microenvironmental and molecular information invisible to the human eye. This generates a directly testable hypothesis: that preoperative radiomic scores can predict not only recurrence but also likelihood of benefit from adjuvant treatment. Radiomics is not dead. It is, at last, being done properly.
zh_abstract: [肿瘤学前沿] 影像学界日益形成一种共识，认为影像组学已被基础模型和端到端深度学习淘汰。我们不同意这一观点，本文旨在阐述原因。批评者部分正确：操作者间分割差异损害了可重复性，方法学质量参差不齐，已发表的AUC与临床实施之间差距很大。然而，他们得出了错误的结论。在肾细胞癌（RCC）中，术前增强CT已是每位接受肾切除术患者的标准诊疗，且约30%的患者术后会复发，影像组学仍是一种可立即付诸应用、可解释且可部署的无创预后工具。我们认为，其主要技术局限（分割差异）正被用来反对它的同一深度学习技术所消除：诸如nnU-Net之类的自动分割框架在外部队列中的Dice系数超过0.93，消除了操作者间噪声。我们还认为，在低患病率、高风险的肿瘤学场景中，预训练基础模型所需的数据量并不存在；而可解释性——现已成为欧盟《人工智能法案》对高风险临床AI系统的监管要求——是手工设计的影像组学所固有的，却必须被后加到深度学习架构上。最关键的是，我们提出了生物学证据，表明CT图像编码了肉眼不可见的肿瘤微环境和分子信息。这产生了一个可直接检验的假设：术前影像组学评分不仅能预测复发，还能预测从辅助治疗中获益的可能性。影像组学并没有死。它终于被正确地运用了。

title: Diagnostically Meaningful, Privacy-aware Synthetic Chest CT via Class-Conditional Latent Sampling in Diffusion Autoencoders
